title: IT Support Specialist
description:
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Reporting to the Sr. Director of IT for Auxiliary Enterprises, the IT Support Specialist is responsible for providing general IT support across all Auxiliary Enterprises. IT-related tasks may include setting up, managing, and troubleshooting technology systems used by each business unit associated with the Office of Auxiliary Enterprises. Duties may include providing end-user support with laptop and desktop computers; providing support for card readers, printers or other IT and computer peripherals; assistance with Howard University physical and Wi-Fi network; diagnosing and resolving hardware problems including specialized hardware such as point-of-sale terminals, building controllers, laundry machine interface devices, OR parking ticket issuing hand-held terminals; configuring and updating system and application software; and tracking down data and communication issues.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides technical support for various hardware used across Auxiliary Enterprises including point-of-sale terminals, printers, laptops, desktop computers, cameras, card readers, scanners, contactless readers, monitors, kitchen-display systems, time clocks, building/laundry controllers, building/laundry readers, point-of-sale terminals, peripherals, and other equipment used by contractors and employees in Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Provide Tier-1 support for Dining Service point-of-sale terminals and peripherals.
  • Level Review diagnostics and assess the functionality and efficiency of systems.
  • Work with system providers in the support of various applications.
  • Work with Howard University ETS to implement, enforce and support security measures.
  • Monitor security certificates and company compliance with requirements.
  • Monitor systems to ensure they are operating as expected.
  • Provide technical support to Auxiliary Enterprises contract staff and troubleshoot computer systems and peripheral equipment used by Auxiliary Enterprises contractors.
  • Install and update company software and hardware as needed.
  • Anticipate and make recommendations regarding the replacement or updating of computer items.
  • Assist with installation, upgrades, and the disposal of IT-related products.
  • Coordinate with ETS and off-prem/cloud-based vendors to ensure that Auxiliary Enterprises systems and data are backed up and backups are verified and able to be restored when necessary.
  • Assemble, install, and configure systems and components per vendor specifications BUT within the policies, procedures, and best practices of Howard University, HU Enterprise Technology Services, and Auxiliary Enterprises.
  • Stay updated regarding the knowledge and skills needed to keep up with rapid advancements in computer technology.
  • Maintains logs of activities and completed work and provides reports to the Sr. Director. Specifically, Laundry System Status and the Auxiliary Enterprises IT Asset List. Additional logs may be assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP, networking, and related technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft Windows Operating system.
  • Ability to develop plans for resolving and implementing technical and operational problems.
  • Ability to work independently, to plan and prioritize activities that may span several locations on campus.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical problems due to complex system interfaces.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to operate in an office environment and in the field (various locations across all campuses of Howard University).
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the community.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or closely related field and one year relevant experience; or equivalent combination of a total of five (5) years combined relevant education and experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $60,000 - $69,000

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apurar encargos trabalhistas, bem como executar o processo de contabilização, provisão e conciliação da folha de pagamento em conjunto com a área contábil.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em sistemas integrados de RH e implementação de sistemas é um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Lead Payroll Analyst
description:
Overview

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! The benefits information above is provided for guidance.

Job Purpose

Job Purpose

The Lead Payroll Analyst plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and effective operation of Howard University’s payroll processes. This position supports the review and validation of payroll data, monitors payroll activity for consistency, and assists in the timely processing of bi-weekly and off-cycle compensation for faculty, staff, and student workers. The Lead Payroll Analyst also serves as a primary resource for employee payroll inquiries, offering guidance and facilitating timely resolution with a strong customer service focus. The role helps maintain internal controls and supports cross-departmental collaboration to ensure payroll is administered in alignment with University policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable federal and state regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Nature And Scope

The Lead Payroll Analyst functions as an experienced payroll professional within the University’s centralized payroll structure and supports the accurate and timely execution of bi-weekly payrolls and supplemental off-cycle payments. The role requires close coordination with Human Resources, Budget, Benefits, Accounting, and departmental administrators to verify payroll data, ensure proper documentation, and support consistent payroll operations across the institution. This position interacts frequently with employees, supervisors, and campus partners to address payroll questions and provide guidance on payroll-related matters. The Lead Payroll Analyst must apply strong analytical skills, confidentiality, and sound judgment when evaluating payroll information or resolving issues. The role contributes to audit preparedness, supports payroll reconciliations, and assists with recurring quarterly and annual payroll reporting activities.

Principal Accountabilities

Principal Accountabilities

Payroll Preparation & Support

  • Prepare and validate payroll inputs in advance of each payroll cycle, ensuring HR-provided files (salaries, benefits, job changes) are complete and properly formatted for processing.
  • Perform pre-payroll audits to identify missing data, unexpected variances, incorrect deductions, or tax issues, and escalate findings to the Payroll Manager.
  • Support the Director/Manager during monthly payroll processing by running calculations, reviewing results, and resolving flagged errors.
  • Process routine off-cycle items such as corrections, small retro payments, and adjustments as directed by the Payroll Manager.

Employee Support & Inquiry Management

  • Manage the Payroll Inbox by monitoring, prioritizing, and responding to employee payroll questions related to pay, taxes, deductions, direct deposit, and time reporting.
  • Research and resolve routine issues; escalate complex or policy-impacting matters to the Payroll Manager.
  • Track common inquiry themes and recommend updates to FAQs or procedure guides.

Garnishments, Deductions & Payments

  • Process wage garnishments, tax levies, child support orders, and other wage attachments; maintain records and prepare remittance packets for manager approval.
  • Administer union dues, voluntary deductions, and retirement contributions that originate within Payroll’s purview (not HR-managed benefits).
  • Maintain logs of all remittances and assist in preparing reconciliations for manager review.

System Support (Workday & ADP)

  • Update and maintain basic Workday Payroll configuration items (simple deductions, tax updates, pay schedule updates) under guidance from the Payroll Manager.
  • Execute routine tests during Workday releases and patches; document issues and assist with troubleshooting.
  • Assist with ADP Tax Services interactions, including reviewing tax files, setting up new jurisdictions, and documenting tax notices for management action.

Reconciliation, Reporting & Compliance Support

  • Prepare standard payroll reports (registers, deduction reports, tax summaries) for manager review before final processing.
  • Assist with monthly reconciliations of payroll liabilities, verifying balances and following up on discrepancies with Accounting.
  • Support quarterly and year-end processes by gathering data, running preliminary reports, and assisting with W-2 review.
  • Maintain organized documentation for internal and external audit requests.

Process Improvement & Team Support

  • Document payroll procedures, update job aids, and maintain checklists to ensure consistency and accuracy in recurring tasks.
  • Recommend process improvements to reduce errors or improve efficiency.
  • Provide cross-training support to payroll staff and serve as backup on routine tasks when needed.

Core Competencies

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of payroll regulations, wage attachments, and taxation, with experience supporting complex higher-education payroll environments.
  • Proficiency in Workday Payroll and familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance, including basic configuration, troubleshooting, and report execution.
  • Advanced attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to audit data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain payroll concepts clearly and provide high-quality customer service.
  • Strong Excel capability (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) for payroll auditing and analysis.
  • Proven ability to maintain confidentiality, follow internal controls, and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative team player who works well with HR, Accounting, Benefits, and campus departments to resolve issues and support payroll operations.
  • Adaptable and proactive, with a continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Minimum Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • 3–5 years of payroll experience in a complex, multi-department organization; higher education experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of payroll regulations, multi-state taxation, wage garnishments, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Experience using Workday Payroll or another enterprise-level payroll system; familiarity with ADP SmartCompliance is a plus.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify discrepancies and support reconciliations.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information in accordance with university policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills for responding to employee inquiries and supporting campus partners.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,00-$115,000

description:
Você quer trabalhar duro, se divertir e fazer história? Se sim, a Amazon pode ser a escolha de carreira certa para você. Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Líder de Time para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa Delivery Station da região do Rio de Janeiro / RJ.

Key job responsibilities

Como líder de equipe, você atuará em uma de nossas estações de entrega, fornecendo liderança aos associados e gerenciando o desempenho dos principais indicadores – Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Você assumirá muitas funções e trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. A função envolve:

  • Estar presencialmente na estação de entrega. Amazon lidera operações 24-7, e portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Criar e cultivar um ambiente de trabalho seguro, identificando oportunidades de segurança em sua área de trabalho.
  • Liderar e treinar os associados para entregar o melhor serviço aos nossos clientes.
  • Garantir que os pedidos dos clientes sejam atendidos de acordo com as diretrizes de segurança e qualidade.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

About the Company

Our client is a China-based IoT and telecommunications solutions provider with a global footprint. The company designs, manufactures and operates connectivity solutions including cellular modules, IoT devices, and messaging platforms, working closely with telecom operators worldwide to enable SMS A2P, Voice and IoT connectivity.

As part of its expansion in LATAM, the company is creating its first commercial role in Brazil, focused on building and strengthening relationships with local telecom operators.

Role Overview

This is a commercial, operator-facing role, focused on wholesale telecom and carrier relationships. The position is not technical and not end-customer sales.

The successful candidate will act as the local commercial interface between Brazilian telecom operators and the company’s global teams, supporting market development, carrier negotiations and long-term partnerships. This is a newly created position, offering growth potential as the LATAM operation expands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain commercial relationships with telecom operators in Brazil
  • Support and participate in operator-to-operator negotiations, including:
    • Wholesale Voice
    • A2P SMS
    • Interconnect agreements
  • Identify market opportunities, pricing trends and cost-optimization opportunities
  • Coordinate with internal teams and report directly to a China-based Director
  • Act as the local market representative, providing insights on competition, pricing and regulatory dynamics
  • Support the development of long-term carrier partnerships across Brazil (and potentially LATAM)

Required Experience & Profile

  • 2+ years of experience in the telecom wholesale / carrier environment
  • Background in one or more of the following areas:
    • Wholesale telecom
    • Carrier Relations
    • Interconnect
    • Voice or A2P SMS
  • Experience working directly with telecom operators (operator-to-operator), not only with end customers
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills
  • Fluent English for daily communication with international teams
  • Comfortable working in a new role with high autonomy

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A2P SMS platforms or messaging services
  • Exposure to international wholesale markets
  • Chinese (not mandatory, but a plus)

Why Join

  • Newly created role with high visibility and growth potential
  • Opportunity to work in a global, international environment
  • Direct exposure to telecom operators and international markets
  • Be part of the LATAM expansion of a global telecom and IoT player

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

  • Implementar estratégias para lidar com a seletividade alimentar severa e recusa alimentar, utilizando técnicas de aproximação gradativa dos alimentos.
  • Desenvolver plano alimentar individualizado baseado em evidências científicas, focando em nutrientes importantes para o desenvolvimento.
  • Abordar comportamentos repetitivos ou restrições alimentares, visando a melhoria da nutrição sem causar desconforto ou ansiedade.

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high‑quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.

  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.

  • Mentor others: guide mid‑level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post‑mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands‑on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client‑facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi‑cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: Security Investigator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Security Investigator to join our Corporate Security Department (CSD).

CSD is responsible for providing highly specialized professional, investigative and consulting services to Saudi Aramco’s Corporate and Executive Management, in order to safeguard the Company and its communities.

Your primary role is to conduct Company based investigations, in respect of serious and complex issues, including, but not limited to fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct and lead highly complex and sensitive misconduct investigations, in accordance with legal norms, with specific reference to and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and relevant Company Policies and Procedures.
  • Initiate, administer and plan investigations, and present the case findings to internal control organizations.
  • Provide regular briefings supported by detailed, evidential reports and information to Corporate and Executive Management, in addition to line management.
  • Perform interviews to identify and develop facts to resolve investigative issues and expediently prepare high quality, well-structured and evidential professional reports of investigation.
  • Identify, prevent and detect wrongdoing or offending
  • Provide misconduct and cybersecurity awareness programs throughout the Company.
  • Identify cost savings, reimbursements and recoveries in favor of Saudi Aramco arising from investigative findings and recommend relevant business change practices and lessons learned to mitigate and negate current and future risks.
  • Conduct detailed research (from open and closed sources) and crime pattern/risk analysis, to identify trends, hot spots, actual or potential corporate threats and vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain and organize investigation case files to a high quality and auditable standard in compliance with data protection norms.
  • Liaise with Company stakeholders and external parties as required, in progressing and reviewing investigative outcomes and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coach and develop junior investigators and keep abreast of investigative techniques and legal norms.
  • You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Police Sciences or Security Studies. Degrees in the following disciplines are also acceptable: Business and Management, Computer & Information Systems, and Police Administration.
  • You will have nine (9) years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate investigations with a proven ability in conducting complex cases of investigation, in respect of fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage etc.
  • You will be able to demonstrate excellent organizational, analytical and evidential skills, when conducting investigations and presenting relevant findings.
  • You must have excellent report writing skills and the ability to structure and summarize case findings in a concise, logical and articulate manner in compliance with legal norms.
  • You will be able to build effective work relationships in a diverse and multi-cultural environment is a necessity.
  • You will have a recognized professional certification, in related disciplines, such as a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), International Compliance Association (ICA), Certified Forensic Interviewer (CFI) or equivalent.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology‑driven growth marketing firm focused on growth‑stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e‑commerce marketplace, direct‑to‑consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high‑impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growthe

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.
  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.
  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.
  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.
  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.
  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)
  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

description:
Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Scrum Master?

Sua missão será atuar como facilitador da cultura ágil, promovendo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de projetos e uso adequado de ferramentas utilizadas. Você apoiará as equipes na avaliação de demandas e recursos, acompanhará KPIs e OKRs, e atuará de forma consultiva junto a Product Owners e lideranças.

Como Scrum Master, você focará em:

  • Avaliar junto as gerências técnicas as demandas, viabilidade, alocação de recursos e cronogramas estratégicos.
  • Estabelecer e manter os padrões de gestão de projetos e métodos ágeis (Scrum, PMBOK etc.).

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Como requisitos básicos, buscamos:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos ágeis, preferencialmente Azure DevOps.
  • Conhecimento prático dos frameworks Scrum.
  • Vivência em Gestão de Projetos tradicional.
  • Capacidade de criar e interpretar métricas de desempenho ágil (burnup, burndown, velocity).

Você se destaca se tiver:

  • Experiência no sistema Service Now.

  • Experiência em processos de transformação ágil em grandes organizações.

title: Software Developer
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT. You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver high-quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross-functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements.
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team members in development/test technologies, tools, and processes.
  • Location: Tech Center - Ilha do Fundão - RJ

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related field.
  • Expertise in software engineering.
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software.
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such as K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka).
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS.
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI frameworks.
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design.
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite).
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services.
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms, and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI).
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators).
  • Knowledge of web technologies, such as JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, XML, JSON, and/or Ajax.
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards).
  • Exposure to developing in agile and iterative software development processes.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Creator Manager
description:
Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring a Creator Manager to lead client‑facing creator strategy and execution across our Creator Services division. This role owns the relationship between brands and our creator network - ensuring campaigns are strategically aligned, operationally sound, and performance‑driven across platforms, including TikTok Shop, Amazon affiliate, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging commerce channels.

As a Creator Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for both clients and creators. You will shape activation strategy, oversee execution, and ensure creator output drives measurable impact while maintaining a strong creator experience. If you thrive at the intersection of relationships, strategy, and commerce - this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Creator Strategy & Client Leadership: Lead creator and influencer strategy across client accounts, serving as the primary client‑facing point of contact - presenting strategy, performance insights, and optimization recommendations.
  • Campaign Execution: Own end‑to‑end execution of creator campaigns, including sourcing, vetting, contracting, onboarding, and performance tracking.
  • Platform Activation: Activate creators across TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, paid UGC, Amazon, LTK, YouTube, and other emerging channels.
  • Commerce & Creative Alignment: Partner with the Account team and Content Studio to align creator efforts to hero SKUs, commission strategy, and creative frameworks.
  • Performance Monitoring: Track campaign performance and proactively recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Network & Operations: Manage usage rights, timelines, deliverables, CRM systems, and Darkroom’s creator network infrastructure.
  • Team Development: Mentor junior team members and help scale best practices within Creator Services.

Who You Are

  • 3–6 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, UGC, or affiliate programs.
  • Strong client management experience and comfort leading strategy conversations.
  • Deep understanding of creator workflows, usage rights, and cross‑platform activation.
  • Experience with TikTok Shop and affiliate models preferred; exposure to Amazon affiliate, LTK, or YouTube Shopping is a plus.
  • Analytical and performance‑oriented, with the ability to translate creator output into measurable impact.
  • Highly organized and confident managing multiple clients and creator pipelines simultaneously.
  • Strong communicator with a creator‑first mindset and commercial awareness.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. title: Senior procurement delivery manager, Brazil

Senior Procurement Delivery Manager, Brazil leads the Brazil regional procurement team. The individual will create and stand‑up the procurement organizational construct to support the growth of the region. They are the most senior procurement person in the region, and their team ensures regional procurement strategy, oversees purchasing processes, manages supplier relationships, mitigates risks while ensuring cost efficiency.

They integrate business strategies and demand through aligned procurement category strategies ensuring the delivery of commercial excellence, representing the ‘voice’ of the region for the end‑to‑end procurement process. They will liaise with other procurement teams to deliver the region’s priorities, e.g., working with categories when that category delivers into their region. They balance business needs with category plans ensuring they are in alignment.

In addition, they act as the main point of contact for external partners to procurement (PPSA, suppliers, co‑ventures, regulators, etc.), oversee cost recovery of third‑party spend and support business integrity and crisis activities to reduce operational risk and cost. Where applicable, they are a member of the Regional Business Leadership Team (BLT).

They are a people leader for the region overseeing people matters. They work with their peers to share ideal ways of working, making procurement more efficient and effective.

They cultivate partnerships with senior stakeholders and collaborate to deliver step changes in third‑party spend management. Their teams directly influence the business/entity financial plans and the overall value delivery of Finance – procurement. They have high commercial acumen ensuring alignment with business goals and delivering secure, optimal, compliant, competitive, and risk‑managed procurement outcomes, ensuring a safe, sustainable supply chain is in place.

A transformational leader, adept at change management, who builds high‑performing teams through emotional understanding and fostering resilience.

Please can you submit your CV in English.

Key Responsibilities

  • Region leadership: Oversees delivery of procurement headcount, budget, and annual targets for the Brazil region.
  • Builds high‑performing teams in the region through energizing and engaging leadership, providing clear direction to their procurement delivery teams.

  • Cultivates relationships with multiple senior business customers, aligning on business and procurement priorities and collaborating to deliver them.
  • Delivers modernization & transformation activities, leading optimization of regional procurement delivery aligned to the broader procurement strategic transformation agenda.
  • Manages business procurement performance to meet and exceed the relevant performance targets, safety and compliance metrics or targets.
  • Team leadership: Builds high‑performing teams by fostering a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement. Their team has deep technical skills and represents the interests of the region across procurement and the broader organization.
  • Builds region knowledge across the wider procurement organization to ensure delivery of their objectives.
  • Develops the team’s technical capabilities and nurtures accelerator skills; curiosity in external markets, innovation and technological disruption, digital fluency, data‑driven insights, and strong collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Establishes an environment of psychological safety as a foundation for collaborative learning, ideation and innovation.
  • Provides coaching and guidance to their matrix teams and dotted‑line reports on business delivery, external stakeholder interface, risk management and people matters.
  • Promotes compliance with bp's Code of Conduct (CoC), policies and procedures to ensure compliance, actively demonstrates and role‑models bp’s Who We Are expectations.
  • Supplier & external relationship management: Uses storytelling to communicate with impact, respectfully challenging to achieve the right outcomes, resolving conflict and focusing on priorities.
  • Skilled at leading and influencing through complexity and ambiguity, managing virtual relationships in multi‑discipline, multi‑cultural environments.
  • Builds deep relationships, bringing market insights and championing supplier value whilst taking time to understand business needs. Becomes a trusted advisor and critical partner.
  • Builds relationships with the procurement teams globally, understanding feedback and proactively working to build procurement's reputation and value.
  • Maintains close connectivity with procurement leadership, ensuring appropriate prioritization and resourcing.
  • Provides procurement leadership to Operate by Other (OBO)/JV activities as necessary.
  • Transformational Leadership and Change Management: Leads major change initiatives, which deliver incremental value to regions / sites / assets in a dynamic environment.
  • Oversees orchestration of change across a diverse stakeholder landscape.
  • Uses digital tools to drive innovation and value creation.
  • Uses storytelling and good communication to encourage adoption.

Essential Candidate Requirements

  • Leadership and communication: Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills are essential for managing teams, relationships, and complex contracts. Influencing and integrating skills.
  • Experience: A minimum of 10+ years of professional experience in procurement or a related field, with specific experience in areas like government purchasing or local ordinances being a plus; especially given the need for PPSA engagement.
  • Technical skills: Proficiency with procurement and supply chain management software (e.g., SAP, ERP systems, etc.) and data analytics tools are frequently used to manage the procurement process within the organization. Established supply chain strategy for the region, including contract map.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Public Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is beneficial and or equivalent work experience.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Additional Beneficial but Not Essential

  • Experience standing up a new team and infrastructure.
  • Experience working in a matrix organisation.

Why join our team?

At bp, we provide an excellent working environment and employee benefits. We offer an open and inclusive culture and a great work‑life balance. Tremendous learning and development opportunities are available to craft a career path, life and health insurance, medical care package and many others!

We support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to crafting an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly. We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

Risk Management unit Brazil is seeking a talented Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)/ Process Safety Senior/Principal Consultant with a proven ability to tackle complex technical challenges, to join a fast-paced technical safety consultancy at the cutting edge of risk analysis techniques. This is a great opportunity to be part of a motivated team that is a trusted voice to tackle global transformations and challenges, helping our customers in achieving the safety of their assets and operations.

The Risk Management South America team provide a wide range of advisory safety engineering and risk management services to the energy industry, for CAPEX and OPEX projects, in Brazil and worldwide. The Senior/Principal Consultant is expected to liaise with and support several customers and stakeholders including regulatory agencies mainly in the upstream segments, but also in midstream and downstream segments, and tackle energy transition topics, such as BESS, CCS and Hydrogen.

The Senior/Principal Consultant reports to a Team Leader and has responsibility for technical delivery of projects with collaboration of other team members and has technical leadership of more junior consultants besides project management. The role includes customer interaction to find solutions to their challenges and discuss project schedule/delivery, technical issues and solutions. The Senior/Principal consultant will have opportunity to interact with customers and other offices globally.

What we offer

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. title: Field Service Engineer, Shaft Line Solutions
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services – together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

We are now looking for a Field Service Engineer, Shaft Line Solutions (SLS) to join our team working for a better future. This is a permanent position, and candidates may be based anywhere in Chile, Panama, Brazil, or Colombia. The role requires travel of up to 80% of the time (domestically and internationally).

What You Will Be Doing

As a Field Service Engineer, SLS, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliable performance of Wärtsilä shaft line systems by delivering high‑quality field service, technical expertise, and customer support.

Responsibilities

  • Perform Field Service activities according to the work scope.
  • Perform overhauls and repairs on assemblies on site and/or in workshops.
  • Interact professionally with customers during the work execution.
  • Provide internal and external progress status updates.
  • Create Service Work Reports.
  • Ensure that the work is executed according to Wärtsilä QEHS guidelines and site procedures.
  • Continuously seek solutions in accordance to best practises.

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:

Required qualifications

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in the mechanical engineering industry, preferably within the marine sector.
  • Completed apprenticeship or Associate/bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field.
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal).
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 80%, domestically and internationally; must hold or be able to obtain a valid passport.
  • Ability and willingness to work on‑call, providing support during evenings, weekends, or holidays as operational needs arise.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Demonstrated experience in installation, operation, maintenance, and repair of mechanical systems.
  • Excellent customer communication skills with the ability to clearly convey technical information, interact professionally, and deliver effective solutions during service execution.
  • Strong commitment to a safety‑first mindset.

Desired qualifications

  • Ideally 2+ years of hands‑on experience with shaft seals or marine propulsion systems.
  • Knowledge of propulsion shaft alignment and vibration analysis is highly beneficial.
  • Experience working with electrical systems, hydraulics, or automation systems is an asset.
  • Spanish verbal skills are considered an advantage.

Physical & Mental/Reasoning Demands

  • Vision: Close; Distance; Depth
  • Color Perception (Red, Green, Amber)
  • Hearing/Listening
  • Clear Speech
  • Touching: Dexterity; Hand; Finger
  • Ability to Mount and Dismount Forklift/Truck
  • Pushing/Pulling/Stoop/Kneel/Crouch or Crawl
  • Lifting: 45 Pounds; 5 Times per shift
  • Carrying: 25 Pounds; 5 Times per shift
  • Driving (local/over the road)
  • Bend/Squat/Sit and Stand for a prolonged period of time
  • Climbing / Balance

Work Environment

  • Works Alone / Works with Others
  • Verbal Contact w/Others; Face‑to‑Face Contact
  • Inside / Outside
  • Extreme Heat / Extreme Cold
  • Noise
  • Mechanical Equipment
  • Electrical Equipment
  • Pressurized Equipment
  • Moving Objects
  • High Places
  • Fumes/Odors
  • Hazardous Materials
  • Dirt Dust

Last application date: 08/03/2026

This is Wärtsilä

Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on .

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

description:
Proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades são:

  1. 1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
  2. 2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
  3. 3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
  4. 4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
  5. 5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
  6. 6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
  7. 7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
  8. 8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
  9. 9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

description:
• Crescente nível de atividade em ambiente multicultural.
  • Filosofia Lease & Operate – nova estratégia para o grupo.
  • Organização enxuta – elevada necessidade de controle de custos.
  • Posição residente no Rio de Janeiro com viagens frequentes ao offshore.

Actividades

O funcionário deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado para resguardar a integridade das pessoas, preservando o meio ambiente e os recursos, contribuindo para melhorar nossa eficiência energética, a descarbonização dos ativos da Companhia e sua reputação.

  • Implementar e reforçar a política de HSE da afiliada e garantir que os objetivos de HSE da afiliada sejam alcançados.
  • Garantir que as normas e instruções de segurança e proteção ambiental sejam respeitadas ao longo de toda a cadeia de produtos químicos.
  • Garantir que o flare e a água rejeitada na unidade sejam monitorados e controlados, bem como reunir e manter atualizados os relatórios correspondentes.
  • Fazer interface com a Contratada e com o HSE da companhia para garantir que os produtos químicos de combate a incêndio e contenção de derramamentos estejam disponíveis na unidade.
  • Garantir que os cartões de DGS e auditorias emitidos com ações relacionadas a produtos químicos recebam a devida prioridade.
  • Garantir a melhoria da eficiência energética do FPSO e a redução das emissões de GHG relacionadas à função de tratamento.
  • Emitir a política de flaring para a unidade.

GEE & Eficiência Energética

  • Garantir o monitoramento diário dos GHG do FPSO e manter as informações atualizadas.
  • Acompanhar quaisquer anomalias nas variações de GHG e nos KPIs de desempenho energético, realizar investigações e ser proativo na sugestão de soluções para implementação offshore.
  • Acompanhar as iniciativas de melhoria de GHG & Eficiência Energética em colaboração com a Contratada do FPSO, assegurando o acompanhamento técnico e orçamentário desde a fase conceitual até a fase de implementação.
  • Garantir boa coordenação com o departamento de Planejamento & Desenvolvimento, bem como com a Matriz, para assegurar consistência nos números de reporte de GHG, no orçamento, no plano de longo prazo e no status das iniciativas.
  • Participar das reuniões periódicas do Sistema de Gestão de Energia.
  • Participar ativamente das auditorias internas e externas ISO 50001.

Desempenho de Produção

  • Garantir o acompanhamento diário dos diferentes sistemas de topside para identificar e antecipar possíveis preocupações.
  • Garantir a elaboração e atualização contínua da simulação de topside do FPSO, considerando a composição mais recente das diferentes correntes.
  • Participar da resolução de problemas de produção/injeção (paradas, flaring, indisponibilidade de unidades, condições anormais de operação etc.).
  • Participar da análise de perdas de produção/injeção em coordenação com o Balanço de Materiais.
  • Realizar auditorias regulares na unidade.
  • Participar de estudos, análises de risco, HAZOPs e auditorias relacionados à produção/tratamento, conduzidos internamente ou pela MODEC.
  • Contribuir para o aprimoramento da expertise de produção, desenvolvimento de documentos de referência, métodos de cálculo e ferramentas.
  • Emitir procedimentos operacionais relacionados a operações específicas preparadas onshore, bem como revisar os procedimentos da unidade na frequência necessária.

Processo

  • Liderar estudos de resolução de problemas de processo e de eliminação de gargalos da planta.
  • Apoiar o engenheiro de tratamento na definição e implementação da estratégia de tratamento químico, em linha com os requisitos de garantia de escoamento e processo.
  • Coordenar as atividades relacionadas à Unidade de Remoção de Sulfato (SRU), garantindo alta disponibilidade do sistema.
  • Coordenar as atividades relacionadas à unidade de Desidratação de Gás, garantindo alta disponibilidade do sistema.
  • Coordenar as atividades relacionadas ao processamento de óleo, garantindo alta disponibilidade do sistema.
  • Garantir que as amostras exigidas onshore (afiliada, Matriz e/ou autoridades) sejam coletadas, enviadas e entregues com segurança e dentro do prazo.
  • Garantir boa coordenação com a contratada de L&O do FPSO para assegurar que problemas sejam identificados antecipadamente e que planos de ação sejam implementados, incluindo potenciais Modificações de Mudança.

Orçamento

  • Participar e contribuir para a elaboração do plano de longo prazo e do orçamento dos ativos operados.
  • Propor iniciativas para reduzir/otimizar OPEX.
  • Inovar em soluções digitais que possam reduzir OPEX.

Responsabilidades

  • HSE: Cumprir e fazer cumprir regras e diretrizes. Realizar treinamentos necessários. Relatar anomalias e antecipar questões ambientais.
  • Produção: Otimizar diretrizes operacionais e fornecer suporte à unidade, reduzindo perdas não planejadas.
  • Plano de Trabalho: Contribuir para seu desenvolvimento e implementação visando segurança, produção e custos.
  • Interface: Coordenar-se com a equipe offshore e time onshore para garantir continuidade operacional.
  • Custos: Liderar e controlar forecast e execução orçamentária para otimizar OPEX, promovendo cultura de custos.

Profil du candidat

Qualificações e Experiência Necessárias

  • Formação: Graduação em Engenharia Química ou equivalente.
  • Experiência: Aproximadamente 5 anos na indústria de O&G, em posições de processo/tratamento. Experiência offshore recomendada.
  • Competências Técnicas: Segurança, proteção ambiental, produção e processo de O&G, start-up de planta e poços, reporting, engenharia de projetos e modificações, logística e gestão contratual.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente.

title: Safety Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Safety Engineer to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, help them to effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System (Occupational & Process Safety) expectations and associated programs, as well as to assure compliance to all company safety requirements.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

Job Requisition ID: 65247

Department: Human Resources (DEPT_HR)

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.
