description:
About the job

Did you know Hopper technology powers some of the largest travel portals in the world? Our Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) platform drives travel purchases for major global brands — from banks to airlines to fintech leaders. This platform is essentially a configurable, multi-tenant travel commerce engine, enabling partners to launch world‑class hotel and travel booking experiences faster, with less custom engineering.

Our Stays & Packages team focuses specifically on accommodation and bundled travel experiences: hotels, alternative stays, and packages combining flights, cars, and lodging. We build the booking flows, search experiences, checkout journeys, and platform capabilities that power these products across multiple partner portals worldwide.

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend / Full-Stack Engineer who wants to work at the intersection of travel product, platform engineering, and user experience.

This role isn’t just about shipping UI features; it’s about shaping how lodging and package booking experiences scale across partners while maintaining performance, usability, and long‑term maintainability.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Work with a group of top‑tier engineers in a low‑process environment powered by trust and autonomy
  • Drive decisions and consensus asynchronously with thoughtful documentation
  • Ship fast. Learn fast. Repeat. Build new features from top to bottom, from UX to database
  • Architect scalable front‑end solutions that allow us to efficiently launch new portals.
  • Work directly with PMs and business partners to help define and refine our roadmap. Your voice matters.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally with a diverse group of people, giving and receiving feedback for growth

An ideal candidate has:

  • Deep expertise in React with modern compiler‑driven patterns (functional components, hooks, performance optimizations, server‑side rendering, hydration, and advanced state management).
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, with experience developing and maintaining enterprise‑scale applications.
  • Advanced CSS knowledge (Tailwind, SCSS, CSS‑in‑JS, animations, and handling browser quirks).
  • Familiarity with contemporary frontend tooling (e.g., React Query/TanStack ecosystem, Tailwind or design‑token‑based styling, modern build tools like Vite). Experience working in monorepos (e.g., Turbo, Nx, pnpm workspaces) is a plus too.
  • Solid frontend architecture fundamentals: performance, accessibility, responsive design, testing, and maintainability
  • Experience optimizing frontend performance (lazy loading, code‑splitting, caching strategies, Lighthouse optimizations, etc.).
  • Experience working on complex product flows such as e‑commerce, travel, marketplace, or fintech applications.
  • Ability to balance shipping product features with long‑term platform thinking in multi‑brand or white‑label environments.
  • Familiarity with SSR and static site generation (e.g., Next.js) for SEO‑friendly experiences.
  • A passion for writing testable code knowing what to test, what not to test, and what kinds of tests matter in front‑end applications.

Bonus:

Full‑stack engineers with a frontend tilt are very welcome, especially those comfortable collaborating across API design, backend systems and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.). This is a nice to have , but not mandatory .

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers.
  • Very generous parental leave.
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world‑class offerings and support services to their end‑client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.

  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • The candidate must have at least 2-3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • The candidate must be a self‑motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The candidate must have well‑developed analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on‑time in a fast‑paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

Nossas 2 fábricas, com capacidade produtiva superior a 500 milhões de litros por ano, nossa ampla capacidade logística em todo país, somado a um terminal de óleos básicos e uma rede de Distribuidores, atendem mais de 100 mil clientes com nossas grandes marcas, reconhecidas pela sua excelência e qualidade: Texaco Lubrificantes e Ipiranga Lubrificantes.

Descrição e resumo do cargo:

A área de Produtos da ICONIC é responsável por garantir um portfólio técnico robusto, competitivo e alinhado às demandas do mercado brasileiro de lubrificantes — um setor altamente tecnológico, com constante evolução em motores, máquinas e requisitos regulatórios. Aqui, conectamos inovação e estratégia!

Nosso propósito é desenvolver produtos que entreguem performance, valor e confiabilidade, sustentando o crescimento da companhia e a liderança nos segmentos onde atuamos.

  • Atuar como referência técnica interna e externa, apoiando o time comercial em BIDs, testes de campo, análises técnicas e esclarecimento de dúvidas de clientes.

  • Participar de processos de homologação junto aos fabricantes de equipamentos (OEMs), elaborando e apresentando documentos técnicos que garantam robustez e diferenciação competitiva aos produtos ICONIC.
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos produtos, propondo lançamentos, melhorias e descontinuidades com foco em estratégia, custo‑benefício e evolução tecnológica.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção Mecânica III
description:
Técnico(a) de Manutenção Mecânica III

Localização: Rio de Janeiro, BR

Descrição de atividade:

Executar atividades de manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos industriais, assegurando a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho operacional dos ativos.

Atuar na montagem, desmontagem, inspeção e reparo de equipamentos rotativos, tais como bombas centrífugas, exaustores, ventiladores, sopradores, redutores de velocidade, correias transportadoras, trocadores de calor, filtros de mangas e sistemas de moagem.

Realizar alinhamento entre eixos, medições e inspeções utilizando instrumentos de metrologia (paquímetro, micrômetro, relógio comparador, entre outros), bem como executar ajustes mecânicos e intervenções com noções de usinagem, solda e oxicorte.

Interpretar desenhos técnicos e especificações mecânicas para execução das atividades, garantindo conformidade técnica e padrões de qualidade.

Registrar e acompanhar ordens de manutenção por meio do sistema SAP, realizando abertura, apontamento de horas, encerramento de ordens e controle de materiais.

Cumprir e promover normas e procedimentos de segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional, zelando pela integridade própria, da equipe e das instalações.

Possui formação técnica em mecânica e/ou áreas correlacionadas concluso.

Experiência nas atividades descritas.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de turno. Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro - RJ

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver ações intersetoriais, mantendo a integração com a rede de suporte social, fortalecendo e implementando as ações na comunidade.
  • Utilizar instrumentos validados para rastreio e acompanhamento, como o Perfil Sensorial 2, SPM (Sensory Processing Measure), e escalas de desenvolvimento (Bayley, Denver II) ou específicas para TEA (como auxílio no fechamento de diagnóstico via ADOS-2 ou CARS).
  • Analisar o desempenho em Atividades de Vida Diária (AVDs) — como comer, vestir-se e tomar banho — e Atividades Instrumentais (AIVDs).
  • Avaliar hiper ou hiporreatividade tátil, auditiva, visual, vestibular e proprioceptiva que impactam o comportamento e a aprendizagem.
  • Planejar e executar sessões baseadas na Teoria de Integração Sensorial de Ayres, utilizando equipamentos suspensos e estímulos controlados para organizar o sistema nervoso central do paciente.
  • Criar estratégias (uso de pistas visuais, encadeamento de tarefas) para que o paciente ganhe autonomia em higiene, alimentação e vestuário.
  • Realizar em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional o Manejo da Seletividade Alimentar.
  • Promover o Desenvolvimento de Habilidades Motoras focando na motricidade fina (preensão para escrita, uso de tesoura) e coordenação óculo-manual.
  • Prescrever e confeccionar recursos de Tecnologia Assistiva.
  • Orientar a família e a escola sobre como organizar o ambiente para reduzir a sobrecarga sensorial (ajuste de iluminação, redução de ruídos, zonas de calma).
  • Realizar o acolhimento e a orientação parental, ajudando os cuidadores a compreenderem o processamento sensorial do filho e a aplicar estratégias de manejo em casa.
  • Elaborar relatórios detalhados para o Plano de Atendimento Individualizado (PAI) ou Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) nas escolas, sugerindo adaptações curriculares e ambientais.
  • Emitir pareceres técnicos para fins de direitos (como o BPC ou solicitações judiciais para planos de saúde/SUS).
  • Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional.
  • Elaborar projetos terapêuticos singulares em conjunto com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional, desenvolvendo a responsabilidade compartilhada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Neurofuncional, Traumato-ortopedica, Estratégia Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Terapeuta Ocupacional.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Registro no COREN RJ ativo e em regularidade.
  • Desejável vivência nas rotinas da internação.

Atividades:

  • Apresentar-se aos pacientes sob sua responsabilidade no início do plantão, prestando todas as informações necessárias a continuidade de seu atendimento.
  • Assumir as funções inerentes ao Técnico de Enfermagem Diarista na ausência do mesmo, visando dar continuidade e encaminhamento ao expediente do Setor.
  • Cumprir as orientações definidas em prescrição Médica, para preparo dos pacientes para realização de exames e/ou cirurgias, tais como manutenção de jejum, preparo de cólon, entre outros, a fim de garantir a continuidade do tratamento.
  • Observar previsões de altas e possíveis transferências, com objetivo de priorizar os cuidados, agilizando o processo.
  • Instalar no paciente os equipamentos de monitorização, como bombas infusoras e monitores cardíacos, conforme orientação médica.
  • Preparar corpo do paciente nos casos de óbito, a fim de encaminhá-lo ao Morgue.
  • Realizar a aplicação de compressas quentes e frias, conforme prescrição médica, assegurando a integridade cutânea do paciente.
  • Devolver medicações e materiais do cliente em caso de altas, transferências, óbitos ou em caso de modificações de prescrições, todos devidamente identificados com etiqueta do cliente.
  • Providenciar a devolução dos medicamentos e materiais não utilizados pelos pacientes, fazendo lançamento através do Sistema Phostos, garantindo a confirmação do processo.
  • Checar e rubricar todos os medicamentos prescritos e administrados, lançando no balanço hídrico horário de início de dieta, transporte de soluções, infusões, medicações SOS e ACM, assim como valor de glicemia, diurese e eliminações, controlar o balanço hídrico rigorosamente.
  • Verificar, os pacientes em precaução de contato, assegurando o bloqueio de entrada, com uso correto e rigoroso de EPIs.
  • Auxiliar os pacientes na ingestão de alimentos, quando necessário.
  • Conferir e testar equipamentos e/ou materiais dos boxes/quartos, sob sua responsabilidade, verificando o perfeito estado de funcionamento e utilização dos mesmos, quando da entrada de novos pacientes.
  • Admitir o paciente junto ao enfermeiro, realizando conferência dos sinais vitais, identificando o cliente com pulseira.
  • Remover todo material e equipamentos, realizar a higiene dos mesmos e armazená-los em local adequado, em caso de altas, transferências e óbitos.
  • Informar ao enfermeiro plantonista, problemas com equipamentos para que sejam comunicados aos serviços de apoio (engenharia clínica, hotelaria, manutenção predial, supervisão da higiene).
  • Preencher livro de protocolo, no plantão noturno, em caso de empréstimos de equipamento e/ou materiais para outros Setores de Enfermagem.

Outras informações:

  • Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro – RJ.
  • Escala de trabalho: À combinar.
  • Disponibilidade para treinamento.

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Desempenhar, sob intensa supervisão, atividades de complexidade restrita relacionadas à manutenções elétricas preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos de produção, bem como os serviços de montagem, teste, ajuste e modificação de circuitos elétricos relacionadas ao processo produtivo.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Utilizar testes (como a BPM – Bateria Psicomotora) para avaliar tonicidade, equilíbrio, lateralização, noção de corpo, estruturação espaço-temporal e praxia global/fina.
  • Identificar como a criança processa estímulos do ambiente e como isso afeta sua organização motora e emocional.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e revisão do Projeto Terapêutico Singular dos pacientes, em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional.
  • Desenvolver a Consciência Corporal trabalhando a imagem e o esquema corporal para que a criança reconheça seus limites físico-espaciais.
  • Atuar na regulação do tônus e postura em casos de hipotonia (comum no TEA) ou rigidez, promovendo melhor controle postural.
  • Desenvolver o planejamento motor (ideação e execução), essencial para atividades de vida diária (comer, vestir-se, escrever).
  • Promover a Facilitação da Comunicação Não-Verbal ensinado a usar o corpo e o gesto como formas de expressão, especialmente para pacientes com barreiras na linguagem oral.
  • Realizar orientações para o domicílio prescrevendo atividades simples que estimulem a autonomia e a organização motora dentro de casa.
  • Elaborar Laudos redigindo relatórios detalhados que auxiliem o fechamento de diagnósticos ou a atualização do quadro clínico junto à equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Realizar orientação escolar através de visitas ou fornecer diretrizes para que os professores adaptem atividades físicas e recreativas às necessidades do aluno.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Psicomotricidade, área da saúde ou educação;
  • Especialização em Psicomotricidade;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função;
  • Desejável experiência em desenvolvimento infantil ou reabilitação pediátrica.
  • Conselho de Classe Ativo na área de formação.

description:
Job Description

Job Number:

Supervisor de Reservas (HOT0CCRG)

Work Locations

Hilton Barra Rio de Janeiro
Avenida Abelardo Bueno Barra

A Reservations Supervisor oversees the Reservations Team and how it performs routine procedures in order to maximise revenue and Guest satisfaction.

What will I be doing?

As Reservations Supervisor, you oversee the Reservations Team and how it performs routine procedures in order to maximise revenue and Guest satisfaction. The Reservations Supervisor will work with the Reservations Team to develop future and repeat business opportunities. Specifically, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Assist in the day-to-day operations of the Reservations Department
  • Manage telephone, email and other enquiries in a prompt and professional manner and in accordance with company standards ensuring accuracy and attention to detail at all times
  • Understand seasonal and historical trends and work within them to ensure maximum occupancy and average room rates
  • Identify new contacts, develop sales leads, and respond to sales opportunities in order to maximise revenue
  • Produce quotations and written confirmation to all clients
  • Monitor customer satisfaction regularly and resolve any outstanding issues to ensure future business
  • Ensure Team Members are developed effectively, maintain a thorough understanding of hotel facilities and processes, and generate a culture of high quality standards for relationship building, customer service, selling techniques, and billing and processing contracts
  • Ensure bookings are guaranteed and no show charges/late cancellation charges are applied where appropriate, and Reservations policies and procedures are followed to ensure Guest satisfaction
  • Monitor the appearance, standards and performance of the Reservations Team with an emphasis on training and teamwork
  • Assist in the recruiting, managing, training and developing of the Reservation team
  • Regularly monitor the team’s productivity, ensuring deliverables are met in accordance with the company’s established standards
  • Support the Revenue team in activities related to the creation, monitoring, and distribution of reports, as well as Hotel Distribution operations.

What are we looking for?

Experience as a Reservations Supervisor/Leader, or at least 2 years of experience in the Reservations Department.

  • Good organisational and administration skills
  • Positive attitude and good communication skills
  • Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service
  • Confident telephone manner
  • High level of IT skills

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Knowledge of the Opera hotel property management system (PMS) and the Omnibees and B2B Reservas distribution systems
  • Academic background in Hospitality/Tourism or another relevant related field
  • Completion of courses in Revenue Management and/or Hotel Distribution
  • Communication skills in Spanish and other languages

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

Oficial de Náutica (Imediato) – Oceânica Engenharia – Offshore

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar navegação segura, conforme exigido por procedimentos Companhia de Navegação e por garantir que todos os tripulantes em regime de quarto de navegação estão totalmente familiarizados com estes procedimentos;
  • Cumprir e fazer cumprir, por todos os subordinados, as leis e regulamentos em vigor, mantendo a disciplina na sua embarcação, zelando pela execução dos deveres dos tripulantes, de todas as categorias e funções, sob as suas ordens;
  • Realizar a manutenção do arquivamento a bordo e todos os registros da Companhia e outros que são necessários para ser mantidos ou apresentados;
  • Garantir conformidade com qualquer regulamentação legal, local ou internacional, que afeta o navio; – Implementar e registrar treinamento a bordo, como exigido pelos regulamentos internacionais e Sistema de Gestão Oceânica;
  • Reportar sobre qualquer acidente e / ou danos que afetem o navio, a sua tripulação ou sua carga, para a Companhia e outras partes, conforme necessário;
  • Administrar as despesas de viagem e a utilização de recursos;
  • Assegurar que cada tripulante assume a responsabilidade pessoal para os aspectos de segurança, ambientais e de qualidade de próprio trabalho;
  • Responsabilizar-se em garantir que as normas adequadas de saúde e higiene são mantidas ao longo da embarcação; – Monitorar embarque e desembarque de tripulantes;
  • Assegurar conformidade com Regulamentações de Trabalho e Descanso;
  • Supervisionar assistência médica a bordo da embarcação; – Garantir que o procedimento de reclamação a bordo seja aplicado conforme requisitos da Companhia;
  • Executar o contrato do navio de forma profissional e competente;
  • Garantir que as ordens de viagem são compreendidas e cumpridas na íntegra;
  • Assegurar que as Análises de Riscos nas quais os cenários possam resultar em grandes acidentes (Segurança de Processo) sejam geridas de forma eficaz e controlada o tempo todo, os procedimentos de avaliação de risco sejam respeitados a bordo e, se necessário, assistência de base seja obtida para mitigar os riscos identificados;
  • Executar as suas funções em conformidade com as normas nacionais (DPC-NORMAM 13 Capítulo 4 Seção I, item 0403 e Seção III, item 0419) e internacionais pertinentes, bem como conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão Oceânica;
  • Verificar e assinar os documentos após a conclusão das operações;
  • Reunir regularmente para analisar a conformidade do Sistema de Gestão da Companhia, chegar a acordo sobre as medidas adequadas de melhoria, e coordenar a implementação e execução do mesmo;
  • Informar a Companhia quando as instruções de viagem / carga não pode ser cumpridas, e / ou onde as instruções de viagem prevista não são claras / compreendidas;
  • Responsável pelas operações de carga e de lastro para garantir que essas operações sejam realizadas de forma segura e eficaz;
  • Coordenar com setor de segurança e qualidade marítima para melhorar a desempenho da segurança ambiental e de qualidade, por meio de relatórios e propostas;
  • Garantir treinamento, bem-estar, disciplina e outras questões administrativas necessárias para execução das atividades a bordo; – Garantir que as responsabilidades e os postos de Emergência são conhecidos por cada membro da tripulação, incluindo qualquer treinamento que possa ser necessário a bordo da embarcação;
  • Supervisionar a gestão de resíduos a bordo;
  • Garantir que as considerações comerciais não tenham precedência sobre segurança e proteção ambiental;
  • Garantir bunkers e suprimentos suficientes estão a bordo antes de iniciar uma viagem;
  • Proteger os interesses do armador e da Companhia em todos os momentos;
  • Cumprir a Política do Sistema de Gestão Oceânica, na qual cada indivíduo deve responsabilizar-se pelos aspectos de qualidade, saúde e segurança ocupacionais, segurança de processo, assim como pela preservação do meio ambiente em que as realiza, desde que não haja conflitos com as regulamentações vigentes;
  • Assegurar conhecimento e ações de controle quanto aos riscos de suas atividades considerando os requisitos de Segurança, Meio Ambiente, Saúde e Segurança de Processo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciências Náuticas ;
  • Experiência como IMT;
  • Certificado de DP Full;
  • CoC- Certificado de competência DPC 1031 regra STCW II/2 + IV/2;
  • TBS1 (STCW VI/1) – Treinamento Básico de Segurança / Certificado Unificado (ECIN/ESPE/EBPS/ESRS);
  • EOPN/SSO – Curso Especial para Oficial de Proteção Do Navio (STCW – VI/5) ou EBCP – Curso Especial Básico de Conscientização Sobre Proteção de Navio (STCW VI/6) (*Obrigatório caso não apresente o EOPN/SSO);
  • ECIA – Curso Especial Avançado de Combate a Incêndio (STCW – VI/3);
  • EESS – Curso Especial de Embarcação de Sobrevivência e Salvamento;
  • EROG / GMDSS – curso especial de rádio operador geral (STCW – IV/2);
  • T-HUET.

Informações adicionais

  • Regime: Marítimo
  • Escala: 28 x 28

Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação ou refeição
  • Plano de saúde extensivo aos dependentes legais
  • Plano odontológico extensivo aos dependentes legais
  • Seguro de vida
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Curso de Inglês

description:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como coordenador ou supervisor

title: HSE
description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Your responsibilities:

  • Contribute to improving Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) performance and Corporate Responsibility in assigned geography. Support the business by applying in-depth knowledge to offer solutions and advice through delivery of Group-wide performance improvement programs and/or Group Audit Program.
  • Governance: Delivers and deploys HSE training, audit and Group-wide performance improvement programs to the Divisions and Local Business Units.
  • Metrics: Provides analysis of HSE data within area of responsibility. Reports on progress on implementation of Sustainability Objectives and key performance indicators (KPI) as required.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Contributes to assessing emerging trends and legislation in HSE and communicates relevant information on legal requirements within area of expertise and geography. Supports constituent countries to operate in compliance with standards and respective legal obligations.
  • Risk Management: Delivers audit (as per Group Audit Program) and supports follow up of improvement actions in the Local Business Units.
  • Communication & Engagement: Cooperates across functions and with business partners to raise awareness and drive performance, engages with internal and external stakeholders to build commitment and credibility for the COE.
  • Operational Support: Contributes to driving behavioral change and continuous improvement though delivery of training and competence initiatives and expert support to the Local Business Units in line with yearly HSE plan agreed with the Business Units. Supports the sharing of best practice. Coordinates reporting on HSE performance and support delivery of Group audit program.
  • Project Management: Contributes to and/or plans and executes Health, Safety and Environment performance and Corporate Responsibility related projects. Develops and reports on project objectives. Manages project resources such as manpower, financials and other relevant factors.

Your background:

  • +5 yrs relevant OHS/HSE practical experience, with preference within an international company
  • National/international certificate/diploma in HSE/OHS
  • Good communicator with ability to adjust communication to different levels of the organization
  • ISO 45001, 14001 knowledge / internal auditor certification
  • Able to communicate fluently in English
  • Interested in working in an mechanical environment, supporting safety culture development in the workshop and customer´s site (Marine, O&G and power generation industry)
  • Good understanding of mechanical service processes and ability in identification of risk

Your benefits:

  • Pharmacy Allowance.
  • Credit Union.
  • Global Fitness Platform (Wellhub).
  • Profit Sharing.
  • Private Pension Plan.
  • Health Plan.
  • Dental Plan.
  • Life Insurance.
  • Transport Voucher
  • Food Voucher.

We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

Accelleron Data Privacy Statement:accelleron.com/privacy-notice/candidate

Job Family Group:

HSE, Security & Sustainability

title: Pessoa Técnica De O&M Ii
description:
Pessoa Técnico de Materiais

Descrição de Atividades: Responsável pela análise e cadastro de materiais (sobressalentes ou consumíveis) para todo Grupo CBO, visando garantir a padronização, catalogação e confiabilidade das informações técnicas dos materiais no banco de dados da empresa.

  1. Garantir o atendimento das solicitações de cadastro das embarcações, através da análise técnica, pesquisas e validação das informações junto ao PDM adequado para o material ser cadastrado, assegurando a veracidade das informações junto ao fabricante, o NCM correto do material a ser cadastrado em nosso Banco de Dados.
  2. Assegurar eficiência na pesquisa dos materiais junto ao Banco de Dados CBO, através da garantia da não duplicidade dos materiais, inconsistência nas informações, falhas de vínculo e sincronia de dados.
  3. Garantir PDM adequado para cada tipo e natureza de materiais, por meio de verificação de que os materiais estejam descritos, identificados, parametrizados e catalogados corretamente.
  4. Assegurar a gestão das informações técnicas a todos os setores da empresa, através da execução das análises técnicas de cada material a ser comprado, visando a boa negociação com fornecedores, minimizando o impacto na manutenção para obtenção de uma operação com confiabilidade.
  5. Assegurar o NCM, Classificação fiscal, natureza da operação, através da análise técnica junto a classe fiscal e, quando necessário, interface junto ao setor Fiscal.
  6. Assegurar a padronização de materiais para embarcações, por meio de análise do tipo de material e sua natureza e verificação dos seus devidos fabricante e referência, visando que todas as embarcações utilizem o mesmo material com o mesmo fabricante e referências, mitigando o processo de cadastramento dos mesmos materiais com fabricantes diferentes.
  7. Cumprir e implementar as determinações estabelecidas pela companhia, na busca da melhoria da Qualidade, Segurança (Ocupacional e Operacional), Saúde e Proteção Ambiental, prevenção e combate à poluição e/ou eliminação das não conformidades, visando a excelência operacional.

Requisitos necessários: Área de formação: Materiais, Mecânica, Elétrica e afins; Especialização: Metodologia de cadastro de materiais.

O que oferecemos para você

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Bônus
  • Seguro de Vida
  • TotalPass
  • Plano de Previdência Privada
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Acesso ilimitado a plataforma Psicologia Viva

A presente oportunidade é estendida a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) que atendam aos requisitos acima.

Nível de experiência: Pleno-sênior | Tipo de emprego: Tempo integral | Função: Estratégia/Planejamento e Cadeia de suprimentos | Setores: Transporte aquaviário e Extração de petróleo e gás natural

Suporte Operacional

Responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de ferramentas de controle;

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Conhecimentos Obrigatórios:

Coordenador de Logística

Responsável por coordenar e supervisionar as operações logísticas, garantindo o correto fluxo de recebimento, armazenagem, separação, expedição e transporte de materiais e mercadorias. Atuará na gestão diária da equipe logística e na otimização de processos.

  • Acompanhar recebimento e expedição de mercadorias, garantindo conformidade com pedidos e notas fiscais.
  • Monitorar prazos de entrega e desempenho das operações.
  • Apoiar o controle de estoque, inventários e movimentações.
  • Atuar na prevenção de perdas, avarias e divergências.
  • Garantir a organização, identificação e layout adequado do armazém.
  • Acompanhar carregamentos, descargas e roteirização quando aplicável.
  • Registrar e reportar ocorrências operacionais e indicadores básicos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, qualidade e procedimentos internos.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Compras, Transporte, Produção e Comercial.

title: OPERADOR(A) LOGISTICA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimization by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets. The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast‑paced, high‑pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a hands‑on, solution‑oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites.
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Purpose

Assures compliance with the scope of work, HRSA guidance, and serves as a Training Coordinator for all activities planned by the project, including needs assessment, data collection, and programming for all projects, including: Core, Minority AIDS Initiative, CDC, Inter‑Professional Education, Practice Transformation, Ending the HIV Epidemic and COVID-19.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators and employees from all divisions and departments within the university structure. External contacts include auditors, representatives from federal, state and local regulatory agencies and vendors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Monitor evaluate and record training activities and program effectiveness. Setup and coordinate HIV‑related topic training programs to help DC Metropolitan healthcare professionals maintain or improve job skills. Assess training needs through surveys, interviews with employees, focus groups, or consultation with managers, instructors or customer representatives.
  • Develop alternative training methods if expected improvements are not seen. Organize and develop, or obtain, training procedure manuals and guides and course materials such as handouts and visual materials.
  • Organizing and facilitating monthly video conference calls, in person meetings, training events
  • Present information, using a variety of instructional techniques and formats such as role playing, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, videos and lectures.
  • Evaluate training materials prepared by trainers/subject matter experts such as outlines, text, and handouts.
  • Design, plan, organize and direct orientation and training for employees or customers of industrial or commercial establishment. Monitor training costs to ensure budget is not exceeded and prepare budget reports to justify expenditures. Select and assign instructors to conduct training.
  • Works with subcontractors to ensure the programs are developed that identify training needs, and effectively reach targeted audience and enhance the quality of education. Manages the certification process for continuing education credits for the designated professions.
  • Increases the center’s participation in collaborative efforts among varied professional organizations, pharmaceuticals, community‑based organization, professional schools and state and local government agencies.
  • Participates in all conferences and communications to subcontracts.
  • Supports the efforts of the department in organizing, maintaining and appropriate documentation to the Department Chair and Associate Dean of the school or department.
  • Maintaining files for the various MidAtlantic AIDS Education and Training Center projects and helping organize all required documentation to and from our funders and regional partner sites.
  • Meets Program Quarterly goals and creates reports for internal staff regarding programmatic activities.
  • Create training schedules for all programs, track and create reports on outcomes of all training and maintain training records for the department.
  • Attend seminars and meetings to learn new training methods and techniques and use the knowledge to prepare and coordinate future training sessions.
  • Recruit new speakers.
  • Prepare and submit speaker contracts to the Regional Coordinator.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with community‑based agencies, local, and state government.
  • Prepare and submit monthly reports on projects outcome and related activities.
  • Enter all technical assistance and activities in the database.
  • Provide customized coaching at the clinical site (e.g., CIDMAR) by working with the site to identify site‑specific needs and opportunities, prioritizing areas of focus, and identifying available and needed resources.
  • Address barriers to effective implementation of improvement processes; propose solutions for practices/health centers to consider in addressing barriers.
  • Advise individual clinical sites on the implementation of the interventions and measures, sharing specific best practice examples.
  • Serve as an active member of a practice transformation learning collaborative group.
  • Interact and collaborate with other practice coaches and planning groups. Receive training on practice coaching and the interventions and tools for site implementation.
  • Ensure implementation fidelity. Transparently share challenges and barriers regarding site implementation and share solutions for effectively implementing the interventions.
  • Work within the learning collaborative group to further refine the interventions, measures, and associated tools. Research and develop innovative ideas for future spread of best practices.
  • Create and/or assist in the creation of materials and presentations and assist with logistical coordination of training events.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the principles and procedures related to HIV education and training.
  • Ability to develop curriculum for programs.
  • Ability to use standard office equipment, which includes a computer and projector.
  • Ability to analyze and develop action plans in resolving and/or implementing organizational and operational problems, issues and goals.
  • Competence in both oral and written English to communicate in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and customers.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in related field with 2‑5 years of related experience. 10 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.

Objetivo do Cargo

Procuramos um(a) Analista Júnior de Red Team / Pentest para integrar nossa equipe de Segurança Ofensiva, atuando nas avaliações técnicas de segurança, testes de intrusão e simulações de ataques avançados. Contribuirá para a identificação de vulnerabilidades, exploração controlada e desenvolvimento de melhorias contínuas nos controles de segurança dos ambientes corporativos.

A posição é ideal para quem já possui experiência inicial e domínio básico das principais ferramentas e metodologias de segurança ofensiva, além de interesse contínuo na evolução das técnicas de ataque e defesa cibernética.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades

  • Executar testes de intrusão em aplicações web, APIs, redes internas e externas.
  • Conduzir avaliações de vulnerabilidades, análise de riscos técnicos e exploração controlada de falhas.
  • Apoiar e desenvolver atividades de simulação de ataques (Red Team Assessments) utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos e executivos, incluindo evidências, impactos e recomendações de mitigação.
  • Automatizar processos e desenvolver scripts para apoio às operações ofensivas.
  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, exploits, novas técnicas de ataque e atualizações em ferramentas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Blue Team, SOC, Arquitetura e DevSecOps para validação e correção de vulnerabilidades.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de playbooks, metodologias e padrões internos de pentest e Red Team.

Requisitos e qualificações

Necessário

  • Formação completa em Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Pentest, Red Team, Ethical Hacking ou funções equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento prático das principais ferramentas: Nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, SQLmap, Wireshark, OWASP ZAP.
  • Conhecimento em ambientes Windows e Linux, permissões, serviços e vetores de ataque comuns.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias: OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, PTES, NIST SP.
  • Noções de desenvolvimento seguro e pipelines DevSecOps (CI/CD, Git, integração de scanners automatizados).
  • Capacidade de documentação clara, objetiva e orientada a impacto.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

You will be working directly with Toptal’s clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with talent from our network, and provide support during the matching process. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Work with clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with experts from different specialties within our talent network (Marketing Experts, Product Manager, Project Manager, among others), and provide support during the matching process, throughout the engagement, and beyond.

  • Find the right talent to meet client goals.

  • Manage the matching process end-to-end to ensure a positive experience for both the client and talent, including: confirm that talent meets both skills and experience criteria along with the commitment and timezone constraints; negotiating talent rates to ensure the talent falls within the client’s stated budget; track, understand, and incorporate client and talent feedback to increase the likelihood of success.
  • Work collaboratively with other teams to effectively take advantage of opportunities, remove friction in the process, and deal with engagement issues when they arise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Full-time availability during US CST, MST, or PST working hours.
  • 3+ years in product and/or project management, with knowledge of both. Proficient in Agile methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of Product and Project lifecycles and roles.
  • Strong understanding of web/mobile apps, cloud technologies, and AI.
  • Familiar with roles in application development: Designer, Developer (Front/Back End, Full Stack, DevOps, QA), Project Manager/Scrum Master, Product Manager/Owner, Digital Marketing.
  • 3+ years in Digital Marketing strategy and/or campaign execution (Preferred experience at a Marketing/Digital agency).
  • Solid understanding of, and expertise in, at least 3 of the following: SEO, Paid Advertising, Email Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Marketing Strategy, Analytics, Tools + Automation.
  • Strong understanding of product/business problems and industry-standard solutions.
  • Excellent communication, relationship development, and emotional intelligence skills to manage client relationships, excelling at active listening, negotiation, and closing.
  • Strong adaptability to learn and execute in new areas of expertise.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both clients and internal teams.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Purpose

  • As Material Controller, your core responsibility is to manage and maintain the flow of materials required for projects and for the operations. Your role is crucial in ensuring the efficient and effective management of materials and inventory to support uninterrupted project and operations’ execution. This role requires a strong understanding of supply chain management, inventory control, and coordination with multiple departments to support project timelines and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory Management: You maintain and lead accurate counting and records of material in stock. You oversee material handling, storage, and preservation to prevent damage, loss, or deterioration of materials. You ensure that the storage areas are kept clean and organized.
  • Material Movement: You keep records of the in and out stock movements. You initiate, treat and coordinate the demand of transfer and move of material between storage locations. You handle the distribution of materials, supplies, and equipment based on incoming requests and orders.
  • Coordination: You maintain good communication with the yard, the warehouse or cargo teams with regards to equipment that requires additional coordination from them.
  • Documentation: You maintain and lead the maintenance of comprehensive material records, including receipts, issuances, and transfers, and generate/oversee reports for management and audit purposes.
  • Compliance: You ensure adherence to relevant safety, environmental, and industry regulations in all material‑related activities.
  • Material Planning: You track material consumption, and you collaborate with Projects, Maintenance and Supply Chain teams to support the material requirement forecast and to develop effective material planning strategies. You support the identification of potential material shortages, bottlenecks, and supply chain risks. You support the implementation of proactive measures to mitigate risks and develop contingency plans to address unexpected challenges.
  • Material Replenishment: If you are involved in the material replenishment process, you initiate the demand and the replenishment tasks. You coordinate replenishment or material transfer processes to avoid shortages and surplus.
  • Inspection and material Quality Control: If you are involved in the material reception process, you verify and lead the verification of the quality and specifications of incoming materials. You conduct and lead inspections and address any discrepancies or non‑compliance issues.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Stock Management, Supply chain, or Logistics Management.

Experience

  • Good knowledge of materials used in oil and gas operations, including equipment and spare parts, and industry specific regulations.
  • Understanding of the procurement processes.

Soft Skills (Comportamentais)

  • Aprofundamento em Código: Evoluir de “copiar e colar” scripts para entender a estrutura e criar funções reutilizáveis.
  • Domínio da Ferramenta: Tornar-se referência na ferramenta de automação escolhida pelo time.

title: CRO Expert
description:
Company Introduction

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth. With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods. If you're looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About The Role

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients' websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates. This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members. Your responsibilities will include developing CRO strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients' e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General Responsibilities

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency's clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients' websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands' landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position Specifications

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month

Requirements

About You

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients' CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. title: Lead Engineer / Tech Lead, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (required)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How we work:

  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

Why this role and join us?

You’ll set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

World-Class Benefits:

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Interview process

Do you believe you're a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We'd love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

Please refrain from messaging or emailing people directly, if you are interested, apply directly, your application will be reviewed by a human.

  1. Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  2. First Interview: Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be a exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  3. Role Interview: You will then meet with Mark P - Head of Engineering and Steve C - Senior Growth Product Manager to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design, product trade-offs, and compliance.
  4. Technical Interview: Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate
  5. Leadership Interview: Chat with Mark P - Head of Engineering on leading a team, growing engineers, hiring and other aspects of people leadership.
  6. Meet the CEO: At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus's strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado.
