title: Senior Media Services Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
  • Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
  • Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
  • Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
  • Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
  • Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
  • Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
  • Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
  • Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
  • Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Outlet Manager
description:
Company Description

Our Brand / Sofitel

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture afficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Our Hotel

Our Hotel / SofitelRio de JaneiroIpanema

A landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema re-emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro.

The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art-filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining at the 22nd-floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check-in.

Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Outlet Manager to lead the daily operations of our established Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club while supporting the F&B Manager in the pre-opening development of the F&B division at Sofitel Ipanema .

This role requires a hands-on leader with strong financial acumen, leadership, operational expertise, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences in an upscale hospitality environment.

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club;
  • Ensure service excellence aligned with brand standards and guest expectations;
  • Monitor and control Food & Beverage costs, labor costs, and daily revenue performance;
  • Drive revenue growth through upselling, team training, and operational efficiency;
  • Supervise reservation flow and optimize seating capacity;
  • Maintain strict inventory control and support purchasing processes;
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations;
  • Monitor guest satisfaction scores and online reputation;
  • Handle guest concerns promptly and professionally;
  • Support the F&B Manager in pre-opening activities for the hotel’s outlets;
  • Assist with SOP implementation, onboardingand team training;
  • Participate in soft opening preparation and execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field;
  • Proven experience as Outlet Manager or Assistant F&B Manager in upscale or luxury hospitality;
  • Strong understanding of P&L and cost control principles;
  • Leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams;
  • Commercial mindset with focus on revenue optimization;
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills;
  • Fluencyin English and Portuguese;
  • Ability to perform in high-volume, fast-paced environments;
  • Pre-opening experience is a plus.

Additional Information

How You Will Shine

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre;
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir-faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main);
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others;
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions;
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine;
  • Demonstrate open-mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation;
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design;
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility.

title: Analista de Operações Sênior
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15 ,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24 ,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na orientação técnica da equipe, explanando sobre os padrões de qualidade preestabelecidos, acompanhando as tarefas executadas pelos profissionais em período de treinamento e efetuando a correção das ações realizadas de maneira inadequada, atuando como referência da área na ausência do superior imediato;
  • Analisar um problema novo e propor soluções através de pesquisa técnica e aprendizados com ocorrências anteriores, bem como antecipando problemas, simulando cenários e prevendo os impactos da solução de um problema em todo o processo que atua, a fim de propor alternativas para prevenção de crises;
  • Resolver problemas complexos, criar, inovar e modernizar processos;
  • Orientar tecnicamente os seus pares; Analisar o processo da realização do tratamento e controle de qualidade de água e de afluentes, monitorando os processos de tratamento de água e esgoto em todas as suas etapas (captação, tratamento, distribuição e coleta), para identificar melhorias para utilização de recursos, operação, manutenção e controle dos sistemas;
  • Apoiar na realização de estudos, diagnóstico e revisão do fluxo de atividades;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas com a operação, conservação e manutenção de sistemas de produção, controle de qualidade, abastecimento de água, coleta e disposição final de esgotos, realizando atividades internas;

title: Enterprise Recruitment Representative
description:
ApplyBoard simplifies the study abroad search, application, and acceptance process by connecting international students, recruitment partners, and educational institutions on one intuitive and personalized platform. ApplyBoard is a mission-driven, hyper-growth organization. It has been attracting dedicated individuals for more than eight years who are inspired every day to break down barriers to international education and take their careers to new heights at a company that will invest in their career growth. Our six core values are our compass in our mission to Educate the World and the foundation of our unique company culture. As an organization built on a foundation of diversity, it’s important that our team members are representative of the students from more than 150 countries that we support.

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for the day-to-day support of our institution partners, driving targeted enrollment growth and enhancing partner satisfaction. You will execute recruitment strategies, assist in conversion initiatives, and act as a liaison between institutions and ApplyBoard’s internal teams.

What you’ll be doing every day:

  • Execute Recruitment Strategies: Assist in the implementation of recruitment strategies aimed at helping our partners meet their enrollment goals.
  • Marketing & Outreach:
    • Participate in education fairs; deliver targeted presentations to agents and prospective students.
    • Conduct a high volume of partner engagement (minimum 5–8 recruitment partner visits daily) and train partners on processes, top schools/programs, and admission requirements.
  • Promote Service Adoption: Encourage partners to adopt premium services and tools that enhance overall satisfaction and results.
  • Liaison Responsibilities: Serve as a friendly point of contact for institutional stakeholders, promoting clear communication and collaboration with ApplyBoard teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams to understand partner-specific needs, troubleshoot any issues, and support solutions for operational challenges.
  • CRM Management: Maintain accurate records in our CRM system, documenting partner activities and performance data regularly.
  • Relationship Building: Conduct regular check-ins with the institution's international recruitment and admissions teams to build relationships and align strategies.
  • Workshops and Training Support: Plan and deliver regional webinars and seminars with recruitment partners and the internal sales team.

What you bring to the table:

  • 0-1 year of experience in account management, sales, or recruitment, preferably in the education sector.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong understanding of enrollment processes and strategies within differentiated institutions.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Proficient in CRM software and data analysis tools.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Extensive travel (15–20 working days per month)

About ApplyBoard

ApplyBoard empowers students around the world to access the best education. With more than 1,000,000 students from over 150 countries helped with their journey in less than a decade, we are just getting started.

ApplyBoard’s global team assists students and our 1,500+ partner institutions by empowering the international student sector with innovative technology and insights. As a five-time consecutive Deloitte Fast 50 and Fast 500 ranked company, ApplyBoard keeps international students at the heart of everything we do.

Thank you for your interest in joining the ApplyBoard Team and being part of our mission to Educate the World. While we are lucky to attract a high level of interest in each of our roles, only qualified applicants will be contacted and selected for an interview.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, and/or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

ApplyBoard welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

title: Digital Analytics - Pleno
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Digital Analytics - Pleno você vai somar ao time de Marketing Data que tem como objetivo garantir a confiabilidade dos dados e impulsionar decisões de marketing guiadas por insights.

No dia a dia o seu papel será dividido em quatro pilares de atuação:

Engenharia de Tracking e Implementação

  • Liderar Implementações: Conduzir e supervisionar o ciclo completo de projetos de tracking, trabalhando em parceria com os times de Engenharia e Tecnologia
  • Tradução Técnica: Atuar como ponte entre Marketing (Paid Media, CRM, SEO, etc.) e Tecnologia, traduzindo objetivos de negócio e KPIs em requisitos técnicos detalhados (plano de medição)
  • Desenvolvimento de Data Layer e Tags: Projetar, implementar e validar o dataLayer, scripts de coleta de dados e pixels de mídia no Google Tag Manager (GTM), garantindo a captura correta de eventos e interações

Análise e Extração de Dados

  • Extração e Interpretação de Dados: Utilizar SQL no BigQuery para extrair, organizar e interpretar grandes volumes de dados, identificando tendências, oportunidades de otimização e desafios de performance
  • Mensuração de KPIs: Colaborar com os times internos para entender as necessidades de métricas e KPIs (Aquisição, Ativação, Retenção, Receita), garantindo que sejam corretamente mensurados e que os relatórios reflitam a performance real do negócio

Governança e Qualidade de Dados

  • Assegurar a Qualidade: Definir, documentar e aplicar padrões de Governança de Dados, incluindo a criação e manutenção da documentação técnica (Measurement Plan / Dicionário de Métricas)
  • Auditoria e QA: Implementar rotinas de auditoria e Controle de Qualidade (QA), utilizando debuggers e ferramentas de proxy para garantir a precisão e integridade dos dados coletados e dos relatórios
  • Viabilizar AI/ML: Melhorar continuamente a confiabilidade dos dados para construir uma base sólida, viabilizando modelos de Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning de alta performance

Gestão de Projetos e Colaboração

  • Gestão Ágil: Organizar, gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de tracking e projetos de dados, utilizando princípios de metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação para traduzir conceitos técnicos em orientações claras para stakeholders de marketing e tecnologia
  • Perfil Colaborativo: Ser proativo(a) e atuar como um parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das equipes de Negócios e Produto, prosperando em um ambiente dinâmico

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Marketing, Tecnologia, Estatística ou áreas correlacionadas
  • Proficiência em Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) e forte compreensão do design da camada de dados (dataLayer)
  • Proficiência em SQL e familiaridade com data warehouses (como BigQuery) e modelagem de dados
  • Capacidade de mapear o funil de E-commerce e mensurar o ciclo de vida do cliente
  • Compreensão básica de JavaScript aplicada à implementação de rastreamento web
  • Experiência em rotinas de Controle de Qualidade (QA) e documentação técnica (Measurement Plan)
  • Conhecimento intermediário de ferramentas de Analytics para App (ex.: AppsFlyer, Adjust)
  • Curiosidade e entusiasmo para explorar o uso de Inteligência Artificial (AI) e Machine Learning em análises
  • Colaboração e Proatividade: Possuir um perfil altamente colaborativo, atuando como parceiro estratégico das equipes de Negócios e Produto, e demonstrando proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de análise

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento básico de Python para análise de dados e automação
  • Conhecimento básico de como funcionam modelos de Machine Learning (atribuição baseada em dados, predição de churn)
  • Experiência com Customer Data Platform (CDP) e integração de dados de plataformas de mídia paga (Meta Ads, TikTok, Google Ads) e CRM (Salesforce)
  • Conhecimento de princípios de metodologia ágil

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

Background

  • The Laboratory Technician is responsible for ensuring the product specification is correct in terms of BS &W by sampling and analysis. They have a specific responsibility for ensuring chemical stocks and rates are maintained at appropriate levels and that sample reports are communicated effectively.

Authority

  • The Laboratory Technician has authority over subordinates.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Carry Out Routine Sampling And Testing /Analysis Operation
  • 1 Prepare for sampling and obtain representative samples.
  • 2 Maintain integrity of samples before analyzing.
  • 3 Prepare for simple testing / analysis Prepare sample for test / analysis. Conduct test / analysis.
  • 4 Record test / analysis results within appropriate documentation.
  • 2) Maintain safe and healthy conditions in the working environment.
  • 1 Comply with the necessary conditions for an effective and safe working environment.
  • 2 Follow incident and emergency procedures as required.
  • 3 Maintain an effective and safe working environment.
  • 4 Limit the damage to persons or property in the event of an incident or emergency.
  • 3) Ensure That Laboratory And Field Test-Equipment Is Calibrated And Maintained
  • 1 Identify calibration requirements for Laboratory and field test equipment.
  • 2 Monitor adherence to calibration requirements.
  • 3 Calibrate equipment / arrange for calibration of equipment as required.
  • 4 Report and record calibration details within appropriate documentation.
  • 4) Control Stocks Of Equipment, Materials And Chemicals Required For Laboratory And Plant
  • Order stocks to maintain minimum levels.
  • Receive and store stock, (including bunkering of chemicals) as required.
  • Optimize stock usage to always maintain levels.
  • Issue stock / ensure that adequate levels are available for other users.
  • 5) Communicate Information (Written And Orally), Accurately, Concisely And Promptly
  • Process incoming and outgoing communications.
  • Receive and relay oral and written messages, data, logs etc.
  • Supply information for specific purposes / tasks.
  • Communicate with Supervisors, peers and external parties accurately, concisely and promptly.
  • 6) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation. 2
  • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 7) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Offshore - Handover

Offshore - Laboratory

Offshore - Field Operations

Offshore - Stock monitoring - Chemicals

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Qualification in Chemistry required.
  • Experience as a Lab Technician in the hydrocarbon processing industry (FPSO experience preferred).
  • Practical experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world‑class offerings and support services to their end‑client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Quantitative Project Manager at M3 Global Research.

The Mission

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.

  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.

  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • The candidate must have at least 2-3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • The candidate must be a self‑motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The candidate must have well‑developed analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on‑time in a fast‑paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior(DevOps) – Grupo Montreal – Home Office
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software Sênior(DevOps) – Grupo Montreal – Home Office

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um DevOps Engineer Sênior, com sólida experiência em Microsoft Azure, para integrar um time multidisciplinar responsável por manter, automatizar, otimizar e evoluir a infraestrutura.

Esse profissional terá papel essencial para garantir:

  • Automação de processos
  • Segurança robusta da infraestrutura
  • Suporte a sistemas críticos do setor público
  • Implementação de boas práticas em FinOps, DevSecOps e observabilidade

Responsabilidades Principais:

Infraestrutura e Administração Cloud

  • Atuar como DevOps Engineer em ambiente Azure, garantindo disponibilidade, desempenho, segurança e conformidade.
  • Provisionar, configurar e otimizar infraestrutura como código (IaC).
  • Gerenciar recursos Azure, incluindo máquinas virtuais, redes virtuais, balanceadores de carga, firewalls, grupos de segurança e bancos de dados.
  • Implementar e manter soluções de backup e disaster recovery no Azure.

Automação e Entrega Contínua

  • Automatizar pipelines de CI/CD, aplicando as melhores práticas de DevOps.
  • Implementar e manter pipelines utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, configuração e deploy de ambientes (desenvolvimento, homologação e produção).
  • Garantir versionamento, documentação e rastreabilidade das mudanças de infraestrutura.

Containerização e Orquestração

  • Gerenciar ambientes containerizados com Docker e Kubernetes, preferencialmente AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service).
  • Implementar e manter Helm Charts para empacotamento e deploy de aplicações em Kubernetes.
  • Otimizar continuamente pipelines de CI/CD, garantindo automação, deploy seguro e rollback controlado.

Dados e Bancos de Dados

  • Administrar e otimizar soluções de dados no Azure, incluindo Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL e Azure Cosmos DB.
  • Implementar estratégias de backup, replicação e alta disponibilidade para bases de dados.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e conformidade das soluções de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de dados na otimização de pipelines e arquitetura.

Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Implementar e manter stack de monitoramento com Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor e Log Analytics.
  • Configurar alertas em tempo real com base em métricas de CPU, memória, disco, latência e taxa de erro.
  • Garantir observabilidade completa dos ambientes de produção (métricas, logs e traces).
  • Apoiar troubleshooting proativo e análises de performance de aplicações.

Segurança e Governança

  • Aplicar práticas de DevSecOps, integrando segurança em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Implementar e manter RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) e IAM (Identity and Access Management).
  • Garantir práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo firewalls, SSL/TLS e criptografia de dados.
  • Assegurar conformidade com políticas de segurança e padrões regulatórios.
  • Realizar auditorias de segurança e análises de vulnerabilidades.

Otimização de Custos (FinOps)

  • Monitorar e otimizar custos de nuvem, identificando desperdícios e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Implementar práticas de rightsizing, uso de instâncias reservadas e spot instances.
  • Aplicar governança e controle de custos.
  • Gerar relatórios de consumo e custos para diferentes stakeholders.

Gestão de Incidentes e Operações

  • Monitorar a saúde dos ambientes de produção e responder a incidentes críticos.
  • Atuar em troubleshooting avançado de infraestrutura, aplicações e bancos de dados.
  • Documentar runbooks e procedimentos de recuperação para cenários críticos.

Colaboração e Evolução Contínua

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com times de desenvolvimento e operação.
  • Apoiar decisões estratégicas junto a times de produto e tecnologia do setor público.
  • Participar de revisões de arquitetura e infraestrutura.
  • Contribuir para a modernização de aplicações e adoção de arquiteturas cloud-native.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa (tecnólogo, graduação e/ou pós-graduação lato sensu e/ou stricto sensu) na área de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Experiência sólida como DevOps Engineer ou Infrastructure Engineer em ambientes Azure em produção.
  • Experiência sólida com Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Histórico comprovado na criação, manutenção e evolução de pipelines CI/CD em ambientes de produção críticos.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting avançado de sistemas distribuídos e resolução de incidentes.

Conhecimentos Técnicos – Azure

  • Administração de máquinas virtuais, redes virtuais e load balancers.
  • Configuração e gerenciamento de armazenamento (Storage Accounts, Blob Storage, Data Lake).
  • Atuação com bancos de dados: Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL e Fabric.
  • Implementação de backup, disaster recovery e alta disponibilidade.
  • Monitoramento com Azure Monitor e Log Analytics.
  • Práticas de segurança em nuvem, incluindo RBAC, firewalls e grupos de segurança.

Monitoramento e Observabilidade

  • Experiência na configuração e manutenção de Prometheus e Grafana.
  • Familiaridade com Azure Monitor, Log Analytics e Application Insights.
  • Criação de dashboards e alertas em ambientes produtivos.

Bancos de Dados

  • Experiência comprovada com administração e otimização de bancos de dados SQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL e MySQL).
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de backup, replicação e disaster recovery.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
  • CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) ou certificações Kubernetes equivalentes
  • Certificações em DevSecOps ou segurança em nuvem

Experiência Adicional

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência.
  • Familiaridade com AWS como complemento ao Azure.
  • Experiência com práticas avançadas de CI/CD (Blue-Green deployments, Canary releases e Feature Flags).
  • Atuação com múltiplas ferramentas de Infraestrutura como Código (Pulumi, CloudFormation, entre outras).

Conhecimentos Complementares

  • Experiência com sistemas open source em ambientes cloud.
  • Integração de modelos de IA generativa em infraestrutura de produção.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis aplicadas à gestão de infraestrutura.

JOB DESCRIPTION

PLEASE REMEMBER TO ATTACH YOUR CV IN ENGLISH

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we develop solutions that power the industry that moves the world. Our flexible pipe systems rely on highly precise and reliable structural components.

As part of the Software and Architecture organization in Subsea Production Systems, the Senior Programmer will develop new and current software applications (in-house apps), that will directly impact the work in the departments of Subsea Production Systems.

You will be part of our newly established office in Brazil to improve our support to the production facility in Acu. The rest of the crew is situated in Brøndby, Copenhagen area, Denmark.

You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users during the entire product development process, use your problem-solving approach, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

About the role:

As a Senior Programmer, you will be working with:

  • Internal stand-alone applications supporting different areas in Subsea Production Systems segment.
  • SQL databases.
  • Reduce complexity on current and future code and architecture.
  • Participate in technology projects across Subsea Production Systems
  • Contribute to working smarter in the team.
  • Contribute to increasingly working with AI-applications/integrations.
  • Close end-user collaboration.

What you need to have:

  • Important: Solid experience writing C# full-time.
  • Important: Experienced working with SQL databases.
  • Important: Full stack Engineer.
  • Important: Experienced GitHub and Copilot user.
  • B.Sc., M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science or similar fields or autodidact within software development.
  • Experience with Windows Presentation Foundation, Entity Framework Core and MVVM Toolkit.
  • Knowledge of packaging and deploying containerized applications, preferably using Kubernetes.
  • Important: Experienced GitHub and Copilot user.
  • Pro: Experience working in agile setups and product development environments.
  • Advanced English Skills

Location:

Rio de Janeiro, RJ

What we are looking for:

The role as a Senior Programmer is an extension of the role as Programmer, and for the experienced programmer proving consistent value creation, proactive attitude, self-driven, a fast learner and high level of the relevant competencies. You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users, release often, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

What we offer:

At NOV, we value the well-being, development, and long-term career growth of our employees. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer:

  • Health Plan and Dental Plan for employees and eligible dependents;
  • Meal Voucher and Food Voucher ;
  • Childcare Assistance ;
  • Life Insurance ;
  • Profit Sharing Program (PLR) ;
  • Transportation Voucher *;
  • Gympass *;
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) ;
  • Harvard ManageMentor - access to free online courses in partnership with Harvard University.
  • You can work remotely 2 days per week.
  • Occasionally you will have to go to our production facility in Acu and talk to end users

(*optional programs that may include employee participation)

Send your resume and cover letter in English.

Bring your energy, your ideas, and your talent - together, we go further. Join NOV Subsea Production Systems and be part of a team that moves the world!

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model’s capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.
  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos autonomia e proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

A estrutura de Product Platforms | Banking tem o propósito de prover serviços bancários para todos os segmentos da StoneCo, auxiliando no engajamento da base de clientes, no aumento do LTV e na redução de churn, tornando-se uma das principais fontes de receita da companhia através dos times de Core Transacional, Cartões, Baas, BPNA, Banking Processes e Open Finance.

Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em desenvolvimento mobile com foco em Kotlin para integrar nosso time de tecnologia. Você contribuirá para o desenvolvimento e otimização de estruturas financeiras dentro do aplicativo Stone, criando soluções inovadoras e escaláveis.

description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements. Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

About the Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide. M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end‑client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission

The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
  • Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, manage respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • At least 2‑3 years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • Self‑motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Well‑developed analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present and proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. Ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • Basic math skills and ability to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • Very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on‑time in a fast‑paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

We are looking for a high‑ownership Frontend Engineer to help us redefine B2B travel. At HTS, we thrive on a bottom‑up innovation culture . We don't wait for top‑down mandates; our engineers have the autonomy to identify performance levers, propose new product capabilities, and ship features that move the needle for our global partners. If you love a fast‑paced environment where your code directly impacts millions of users from day one, you belong here.

  • Design & Build at Scale: Architect and review code for world‑class, multi‑tenant travel portals that balance reusable white‑label foundations with partner‑specific customizations.

  • Autonomous Execution: Lead initiatives from concept to deployment. Our group operates with a low‑meeting culture , emphasizing deep work, strong alignment, and asynchronous decision‑making to maximize engineering velocity.

  • Product Innovation: Collaborate side‑by‑side with Product Managers and Designers to explore engineering improvements that enhance the user experience and drive partner growth.

  • Cross‑Functional Impact: Work seamlessly across Hopper’s ecosystem—integrating with our Scala‑based fintech services and GCP infrastructure to bring sophisticated travel features to market.

  • Exceptional Technical Craft: Expert‑level proficiency in React and TypeScript , with a deep understanding of component architecture, state management, and web performance.

  • Product‑Minded Engineering: You anchor your conception of "quality" in the customer experience and understand how to translate business ambiguity into clear, scalable code.

  • Iterative DNA: A natural drive to deliver results fast. You know how to distinguish between "must‑be‑perfect" core logic and features that can be evolved through data‑driven iteration.

  • Systems Thinking: Experience (or a hunger to learn) managing complex frontends within a distributed systems environment, ensuring reliability for high‑stakes partner integrations.

More about Hopper

By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

  • The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

  • While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.
  • Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.
  • Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.
  • Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us: SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Operations Technical Autority, you provide Regional Ownership and accountability of fleet Safety and Environmentally Critical Element (SECE) Performance Standards within their discipline.
  • You act as part of the local Technical Team in assuring the status of the SECE within your scope.

Responsibilities

  • You travel to all units within your scope at least twice a year to maintain a strong connection with front-line operations.
  • You provide independent technical advice to regional personnel, ensuring clarity and confidence in operational decisions.
  • You act as the technical liaison between your discipline, the Operations Risk Team, and subject‑matter experts.
  • You contribute your expertise to local SBM initiatives, enhancing safety and operational excellence.
  • You support Major Accident Hazards (MAH) risk management by participating in Operational Risk Assessments and ensuring alignment with company standards.
  • You accept and oversee Operations Performance Standards for your discipline, reviewing and endorsing proposed changes before escalating to the Global OTA (OTA2).
  • You evaluate and approve changes to tag lists and assurance EMS tasks during project phases, ensuring alignment with assurance requirements.
  • You review and endorse Execute Phase Assurance Reports developed by R3 Process Safety Engineers for new units.
  • You approve updates to EMS and Safety and Environmentally Critical Element (SECE) tag lists as requested by Reliability Leads, ensuring compliance with guidelines from the Global OTA.
  • You monitor KPIs for barrier health in your discipline and escalate concerns to Operations Management.
  • You conduct periodic document reviews to ensure SECE performance and barrier strategies align with the unit's Safety Case.
  • You oversee MAH Risk Assessment and Safety Case Reviews for Brownfield Modifications or Life-Extension Projects.
  • You elevate significant findings from verification and assurance processes to ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • You prepare an annual report on Barrier/SECE management status and the effectiveness of Verification and Assurance Schemes for OTA2 and Regional Operations Management.

Education

  • Minimum Bachelors degree within the discipline for which you are an authority.

Experience

  • Solid experience in technical or engineering roles.
  • Solid experience within an operations setting

Functional Competencies Analysis Hazards and Effects Management - Hazard management - Cumulative Risk Hazards and Effects Management - Hazard management - SBM Assets Learning from events Management of change application Monitoring Audit and Assurance Safety and environmental critical elements Mechanical Rotating Equipment Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Compressor Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Pumps Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Turbine

description:
Analista de Testes Pleno (Automação) – Omie Tecnologia – Home Office

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Desafio: Escalar a Qualidade através do Código

No G-Click, a qualidade é inegociável. Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Testes Pleno para elevar o nosso patamar técnico.

Seu papel não será apenas “encontrar bugs”, mas construir a engenharia que previne que eles aconteçam. Você será a referência técnica de automação, ajudando a transformar testes manuais repetitivos em scripts inteligentes e confiáveis, garantindo velocidade e segurança para nossas entregas.

O que você fará no dia a dia? (Responsabilidades)

  • Você terá autonomia para definir como testar melhor e mais rápido.
  • Desenvolvimento de Automação: Criar, manter e evoluir scripts de testes automatizados (E2E e Integração) para nossas aplicações Web.
  • Testes de API: Garantir a integridade dos serviços testando contratos, status codes e payloads diretamente na camada de serviço (sem depender só da interface).
  • Análise de Causa Raiz: Quando um teste falhar ou um bug surgir, você investigará a origem técnica do problema (logs, console, banco de dados) para dar um direcionamento preciso ao time de desenvolvimento.
  • Integração Contínua (CI/CD): Acompanhar a execução dos testes na pipeline e atuar rapidamente caso o “build” quebre.
  • Mentoria Técnica: Apoiar os Analistas de Qualidade (manuais) e Juniores, disseminando boas práticas de lógica e automação.
  • Estratégia de Teste: Analisar as features complexas e decidir: “O que vale a pena automatizar?” e “O que deve ser testado manualmente?”.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é essencial para a vaga? (Requisitos)

  • Experiência Sólida em Automação Web: Domínio de frameworks de mercado (ex: Cypress, Playwright, Selenium ou WebdriverIO).
  • Linguagem de Programação: Conhecimento em lógica e em uma linguagem de script (ex: Javascript/Typescript, Java ou Python).
  • Testes de API: Experiência com ferramentas de teste de requisições (Postman, Insomnia, REST Assured ou Supertest).
  • Controle de Versão: Uso diário de Git (Pull Requests, Branches, Merge).
  • Banco de Dados: Capacidade de realizar consultas (SQL) para massa de dados e validações.

Comportamentos que fazem a diferença (Soft Skills)

  • Perfil Resolutivo (Troubleshooter): Você não apenas reporta o problema, você investiga o porquê. Gosta de entender o erro a fundo.
  • Visão Sistêmica: Entende que uma mudança no código pode impactar áreas diferentes do sistema e planeja seus testes pensando nisso.
  • Autonomia: Consegue receber uma demanda macro e quebrar em tarefas técnicas, organizando seu próprio tempo e prioridades.
  • Comunicação Técnica: Consegue debater soluções com o time de desenvolvimento de igual para igual, falando a “língua técnica” quando necessário.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com escrita de cenários em Gherkin (BDD).
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

CapsLock is a company that specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses that are facing sales growth challenges. Our comprehensive services include sales consulting, data analytics, and various marketing solutions, all seamlessly integrated to ensure efficient and accelerated growth.

Our company was founded by industry professionals with expertise in IT, design, and data analytics. Our vision is to provide a unique integrated solution for B2C clients that enables profitable customer acquisition, flexible scaling, and internal processes optimisation.

At CapsLock, our core values center around our people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and fostering strong relationships. Our team is diverse and skilled, speaking 10+ languages, and located worldwide. We are dedicated to pioneering new and efficient marketing strategies to ensure our clients’ success.

Role Description

As an HR Team Lead , you will manage a team of three members and report directly to the HR Director. In this role, you will act as a coach and mentor to your team, collaborate closely with other team leads, and serve as a “barometer” of what is happening within the organization. You will help to shape and evolve HR processes, from onboarding and performance evaluation tools to reporting, values, and culture programs.

We are looking for someone who can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, who is flexible, open-minded, and comfortable working across cultural contexts. This role requires excellent communication skills, stakeholder management, and the charisma to build trust and engagement across the company.

Requirements

  • Administer pulse surveys to gather feedback from employees and assess organisational culture and engagement
  • Oversee the planning and coordination of the major company events, including sourcing and negotiating contracts with vendors, travel arrangements, budgeting, event communications, among others
  • Utilize metrics and data analytics to measure the effectiveness and impact of various HR initiatives, making data-driven decisions for continuous improvement
  • Conduct benchmarking studies, prepare benchmarking reports and presentations for different levels of organization to support decision making and strategic planning, including preparation and submission of confidential data to survey companies (ex, Mercer survey submission)
  • Establish and maintain the accuracy and relevance of HR processes to ensure compliance with company policies and best practices
  • Develop, document, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for key HR processes
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the HR department, encouraging feedback and innovation to drive ongoing enhancements to processes and practices
  • Manage employee relations by serving as a point of contact for employee inquiries and concerns
  • Assist HRD in establishing and implementing performance management processes, including goal setting, performance evaluations, and feedback sessions.
  • Oversee HRIS and data management to ensure accurate and up-to-date employee records

Skills and Experience

  • Proven experience as an HR Manager or similar role, with a minimum of 3 years of experience.
  • Knowledge of HR best practices
  • Experience in project management and budgeting
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, business acumen
  • Ability and willingness to build rapport with employees and vendors
  • Analytical skills to measure the impact and effectiveness of programs
  • Fluency in English

Education

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

Personal Characteristics

  • Effective communicator
  • Flexible and accepting of continuous change
  • Comfortable in a multi-language, multi-cultural environment
  • Strong interest in continuous learning
  • Focus on data-driven decision making

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

  • Remote Work - we are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.
  • Paid Time Off - work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.
  • Ongoing Learning - we believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.
  • Home Office - we help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

  • Experiência nas rotinas do Centro Cirúrgico e Hemodinâmica.

Atividades

  • Através do pedido médico, checar previamente se todo o material necessário para início dos atos operatórios, inclusive materiais consignados, encontram‑se a disposição nas salas de cirurgias, priorizando os procedimentos de maior complexidade, a fim de comunicar as respectivas equipes médicas às disponibilidades dos mesmos;
  • Manter a sala cirúrgica de acordo com cada cirurgia e montar a mesa do procedimento utilizando técnica asséptica;
  • Fazer o check‑list dos pacientes na admissão e na saída do centro de intervenção cardiovascular, verificando os itens especificados em formulário próprio para cada situação, a fim de garantir a segurança do mesmo;
  • Providenciar a higienização dos equipamentos expostos, bem como os cabos e fios correspondentes, removendo sujidades dos mesmos e das superfícies, conforme definido nas normas e procedimentos da Unidade;
  • Verificar o funcionamento dos gases e equipamentos e iluminação da sala sob sua responsabilidade, tomando as providências necessárias para a manutenção da temperatura adequada do ambiente;
  • Auxiliar na transferência do paciente da maca para a mesa cirúrgica certificando‑se do correto posicionamento do paciente, da placa de bisturi para o ato cirúrgico, bem como dos cateteres, sondas e drenos;
  • Notificar possíveis intercorrências ao enfermeiro responsável, a fim de resolver a situação não planejada;
  • Preencher corretamente todos os impressos pertinentes ao prontuário do paciente e à instituição, registrando todos os procedimentos ocorridos no ato cirúrgico;
  • Controlar a quantidade de materiais, compressas e gazes e equipamentos utilizados pela equipe médica no início da cirurgia, como fator de segurança para o paciente e controle da Unidade;
  • Auxiliar na paramentação da equipe cirúrgica, bem como abrir os materiais estéreis utilizando técnicas assépticas, definida nas normas emitidas pela CCIH;
  • Encaminhar peças, exames, e outros pedidos devidamente protocolados no transcorrer da cirurgia;
  • Auxiliar o anestesiologista na indução / reversão do procedimento anestésico, caso o enfermeiro não tenha condições de estar presente;
  • Realizar a desmontagem da sala cirúrgica, encaminhando materiais à CME;
  • Checar validade de materiais armazenados no arsenal da hemodinamica;
  • Realizar rotina do setor as 07:00 com registro nos check‑list das salas cirúrgicas e Unidade Pós Angioplastia;

Outras informações

Acreditamos no nosso #timedeestrelas e oferecemos um ambiente leve, informal e respeitoso para que todas as nossas pessoas se sintam confortáveis para ser quem são e, dessa forma, sejam protagonistas de suas carreiras.     • Document technical solutions, agent architecture patterns, and best practices for reusable deployment
    • Test and validate the accuracy and performance of automation and AI‑driven outputs

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in technical roles focused on marketing technology, data integration, or analytics
  • Agency, consultancy, or client services background with a strong understanding of client delivery
  • Deep hands‑on experience with data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery
  • Proficiency with ETL/data integration tools including Glue, AirByte, Python, and custom APIs
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling
  • Proficiency in Python for scripting, data manipulation, and deploying AI/ML models
  • Experience with marketing platforms including Google Analytics 4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and CRMs

  • Client‑facing experience including leading discovery sessions, presenting solutions, and managing stakeholder expectations
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and their AI/ML services
  • Understanding of Generative AI use cases and prompt engineering best practices
  • Expertise in marketing analytics concepts: attribution, conversion tracking, and customer journey mapping
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Prior solutions architect or technical consultant role at a MarTech vendor or agency
  • Experience in MLOps, deploying models to production, or managing LLM contexts
  • Hands‑on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as n8n, Make, Flowise, or AWS Step Functions
  • AI/ML certifications from cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) or specialized platforms
  • Experience with attribution modeling and marketing measurement
  • Understanding of data privacy, compliance, and governance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA)
  • Comfort presenting technical solutions to C‑level stakeholders

Current Tech Stack

  • Data Platforms: Snowflake, Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL

  • Marketing Technology: Meta, Google, TikTok ad platforms, CRMs, CDPs
  • Development: Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), modern web technologies
  • Collaboration: Slack, Monday, Google Workspace

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts.
  • Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

title: Observatório Nacional lança edital do Programa Meninas Cientistas
description:
Observatório Nacional lança edital do Programa Meninas Cientistas

Programa oferece iniciação científica em geofísica e astronomia para meninas do ensino médio de escolas públicas no Rio de Janeiro.

O Observatório Nacional (ON), vinculado ao Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, lançou no dia 11 deste mês o edital do Programa ‘Meninas Cientistas do ON’, em celebração ao Dia Internacional de Mulheres e Meninas na Ciência. A iniciativa é destinada exclusivamente a estudantes do ensino médio que se identificam com o gênero feminino, marcando a primeira vez que a instituição cria um programa de iniciação científica dedicado à formação de meninas na ciência.

O objetivo principal é despertar a vocação científica e tecnológica em jovens, incentivando novos talentos e proporcionando contato direto com métodos e técnicas de pesquisa. O programa estimula o desenvolvimento do pensamento científico, da criatividade e da capacidade de resolução de problemas por meio de projetos supervisionados por pesquisadores do ON. Essa ação integra as políticas institucionais do Observatório Nacional para promover a diversidade e a equidade de gênero na ciência, alinhadas a iniciativas internacionais que buscam maior participação feminina em áreas científicas e tecnológicas.

Nesta primeira edição, o edital selecionará duas equipes de pesquisa: uma na área de geofísica e outra em astronomia. Cada equipe será composta por uma professora orientadora e quatro alunas da mesma instituição pública de educação básica, reconhecida pelo MEC e localizada no Rio de Janeiro. A professora é responsável por selecionar as estudantes e realizar a inscrição da equipe pelo link oficial.

As equipes selecionadas desenvolverão atividades científicas com supervisão direta de pesquisadores do Observatório Nacional, dedicando quatro horas semanais ao projeto: de uma a duas horas no campus do ON, em São Cristóvão, e o restante na própria escola. O edital prevê bolsas de R$ 300 mensais para cada aluna e R$ 500 mensais para a professora orientadora, com o intuito de estimular a permanência das estudantes nas atividades e fortalecer a formação em áreas estratégicas para o país.

As inscrições estão abertas, e as equipes interessadas devem consultar o cronograma oficial no site do programa para prazos de submissão, avaliação e divulgação de resultados.

Descrição da vaga

A Empresa.

A Wilson Sons é uma das maiores operadoras de serviços portuários, marítimos e logísticos do Brasil, e iniciou suas atividades em 1837, em Salvador, Bahia. Nesses 180 anos de existência, a Companhia se estabeleceu como renomada prestadora de serviços pela competente gestão de seus negócios nos segmentos em que atua.

Quem Somos?

Somos conexões que acompanham as tendências do mercado, investem em infraestrutura e tecnologia, inovam em processos e antecipam necessidades. É o nosso olhar para o futuro que garante as melhores oportunidades para os nossos parceiros.

Nossa equipe é composta por pessoas que compartilham os valores e princípios que norteiam a visão de futuro da Wilson Sons.

São pessoas engajadas e comprometidas com a qualidade de entrega de nossos serviços, o que reflete diretamente na produtividade da companhia.

Em nossa Visão, assumimos o compromisso de ser a primeira escolha dos colaboradores e de crescer de forma arrojada, sinérgica e sustentável.

Nesse desafio, buscamos promover e manter um alto nível de engajamento de equipe.

Buscamos pessoas que desejam entregar o seu melhor para crescermos juntos.

Junte-se a nós!

Conheça Melhor a Wilson Sons!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Responder a auditorias internas e externas sobre movimentações salariais;
  • Desenvolver e contribuir na implementação, revisão e gestão das políticas e procedimentos de remuneração, garantindo que estejam atualizados e em conformidade com as diretrizes internas e regulamentações vigentes;
  • Garantir que as regras e alçadas para revisões na estrutura organizacional sejam cumpridas no Grupo WS através de sistema interno ou fluxo junto ao Comex;

  • Realizar a manutenção da estrutura organizacional dos negócios através de sistemas internos de Remuneração, visando garantir a governança e o cumprimento das políticas de remuneração;
  • Atuar, através dos BPs Negócios, na administração e evolução dos programas corporativos de reconhecimento não financeiro (Reconhecimento Por Tempo de Serviço e Reconheço Você), visando alavancar o engajamento dos colaboradores;

Saiba mais sobre a Wilson Sons

Juntos transformamos realidades.

Somos a Wilson Sons , há mais de 188 anos conectamos o Brasil ao mundo através de operações portuárias e marítimas. Muito além da logística, somos movidos por pessoas que aceitam o desafio de movimentar e transformar o país todos os dias.

Cultura e carreira

Nossa longevidade é fruto da sede de desafiar o presente. Valorizamos quem busca ampliar horizontes e tem coragem para explorar novos caminhos. Aqui, a inovação serve ao crescimento de todos.
