title: Senior Product Designer - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

How does Docplanner Tech fit here?

At Docplanner Tech we are a diverse group of over 400 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

Job Description

Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.

We are looking for a Product Designer for software modernization who will be responsible for creating and improving user interfaces, from research and ideation to final delivery, focusing on usability and user experience. This professional will work on the conception of digital products, prototyping, testing, and iterating solutions, always seeking to enhance the interaction between the user and technology. They will also work in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with developers and Product Managers to ensure product quality and efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the long term product strategy together with product leadership: as part of the responsibilities. We are looking for a designer that can influence our long term plan and not only the quarter's objectives
  • Research and analysis: Conduct user research, analyze data, and identify opportunities for improving the user experience.
  • Conceptualization and ideation: Develop design concepts, create wireframes, prototypes, and interfaces, exploring different solutions.
  • Interface design: Create visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces, considering visual identity, design patterns, and usability.
  • Prototyping and testing: Develop low and high-fidelity prototypes, test solutions with users, collect feedback, and iterate the design.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with product, development, and other teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Continuous optimization: Monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and propose solutions to optimize the user experience.

Qualifications

Skills

  • Product design experience: Knowledge in user research, stakeholder evaluation, UX/UI design, prototyping, and testing.
  • Design tools: Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, among others.
  • Communication: Ability to present ideas, listen to feedback, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Problem-solving: Ability to identify and solve problems creatively and efficiently.
  • Technical knowledge: Understanding of web and mobile development principles.
  • Design culture: Understanding the importance of design culture and its application in product development.
  • Understanding and evaluation of flows and bottleneck identification.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in creating interfaces and digital products.
  • Portfolio demonstrating product design skills.

Additional Information

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience. The range is broad so that we can accommodate our roles for all levels of experience, but we will show you the career ladder to explain where we see your skills and impact within the company". Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;
  • We offer a Meal Voucher worth R$800,00 a month, but if you enjoy cooking at home, you can replace it with a Food Voucher, for the same amount, or do half and half, making life easier for those who are 100% remote or hybrid.
  • For the commute to the office, we offer transportation vouchers.
  • We have a robust Partnerships Club, with agreements and discounts ranging from educational institutions. such as colleges and languages, to exclusive banking benefits.
  • Share options plan after 6 months of working with us.
  • Did you like working here? Then refer a friend or relative! We love having family and friends around! Our New Warrior Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months.

True flexibility and work-life balance

  • Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in.
  • Our working hours are Monday through Friday, from 9am to 6pm.
  • Need to work beyond your usual hours? We have a time bank so that you can use those hours as time off later.
  • Additional paid holiday on your birthday and work anniversary.
  • Our special leave policies are different here: if you’ve lost a loved one, we offer 10 days off; if you lose your PET, you have 2 days. Are you getting married? 7 days of rest! The baby’s here? We offer 1-month of paternity leave and 6 months of maternity leave.

Health comes first

  • Medical and Dental Assistance along with Group Life Insurance.
  • We have a robust Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services, all the way to exclusive banking benefits.
  • Access to the iFeel app, for emotional comfort, which combines traditional psychology with AI, helping you through those tough days.
  • ApoioPass offers free professional support and guidance in the psychological, legal, economic, and social areas, providing support in those more delicate issues.
  • A Gympass for you and 3 other people! Because working out alone is very boring, isn't it?
  • Did you think your PET would be left out? Of course not! We offer a Pet Plan extending the care to your pet as well.
  • Credits: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment.

Important: Docplanner is an international English-first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

title: Digital Media Buyer - Remote, Latin America
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for someone with a strong media and advertising foundation; well versed in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Campaign Manager, planning, presenting, executing, and optimizing all media strategies.

Our ideal candidate thrives on data and is adept at using it to craft the highest performing campaigns possible. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Above all, we think having the right positive, engaged personality is crucial for our work culture and to create a passionate tie to our agency’s thriving team philosophy.

Media Buying & Strategy

  • Ability to audit, configure, and troubleshoot conversion tracking across Google Tag Manager, GA4, and platform‑native pixels.
  • Deep understanding of Google Ads Quality Score, bid strategies (CPA, ROAS, manual CPC), and how to diagnose and recover from CPC inflation.
  • Must have experience with Google Ads and Hubspot
  • Execute data‑driven media buying strategies that align with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct market research to identify the most effective media channels.
  • Analyze historical campaign data to inform media mix and performance projections.
  • Recommend channel‑specific budgets and optimize spend based on performance metrics.
  • Stay current on media trends, platform updates, and emerging technologies, including AI and automation tools.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and programmatic display.
  • Track key KPIs such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
  • Hands‑on experience with LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms, Matched Audiences, and B2B‑specific targeting strategies.
  • Experience closing the feedback loop between lead quality and campaign targeting — working with sales/CRM data to optimize for qualified leads, not just volume.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost‑saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Experience building performance reports and presenting campaign results to clients, including attribution methodology and spend‑to‑pipeline analysis.
  • Familiarity with B2B lead generation platforms such as Clutch, G2, or similar directories is a plus.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third‑party trackers, etc.)
  • Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self‑motivated, detail‑oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI‑Remote

description:
At The Coca Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

Brazil is a critical growth and innovation market, where shopper behavior, culture, and channel complexity demand distinctive and scalable retail experiences. Through Shop X, we elevate how brands come to life in retail by connecting brand ideas, shopper needs, and execution excellence.

The Senior Manager, Creative Shopper / Shop X – Brazil is responsible for leading the creative development and execution of shopper experiences across channels, translating Product & Retail XP and Brand strategies into impactful, executable, and commercially effective in store solutions. This role partners closely with Brand, IMX, Commercial, Frontline Marketing, and Bottlers to ensure consistency from strategy to execution at the point of sale.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Lead the development and execution of Creative Shopper and Shop X plans for Brazil, aligned with Product & Retail XP, Brand, and Commercial priorities.
  • Translate brand strategies, shopper insights, and cultural context into creative retail concepts that drive visibility, engagement, and conversion across channels.
  • Own the end-to-end shopper creative process— from idea and design to in-market execution— ensuring solutions are scalable, relevant, and execution ready.
  • Define and deploy Creative Pictures of Success by channel, balancing creative excellence with operational and bottler realities.
  • Ensure shopper experiences are consistent with Experience Principles, Design Systems, and Brand Standards.
  • Partner with Frontline Marketing, Sales, and Bottlers to adapt and activate shopper solutions in market.
  • Lead the design and rollout of POS, displays, and in-store experiences, including pilots, test and learn initiatives, and toolkits.
  • Manage the shopper creative activation calendar, ensuring alignment across Brand, IMX, and Commercial rhythms.
  • Develop clear shopper execution guidelines and creative toolkits to enable high quality market execution.
  • Lead creative, design, and production agencies, ensuring strong briefs, disciplined delivery, and quality output.
  • Own tactical and operational creative shopper plans for Brazil within an established Product & Retail XP strategy.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert in Creative Shopper and Shop X within the market.
  • Leads workstreams and projects with cross‑functional and indirect resources; may coach or manage junior contributors.
  • Operates with autonomy on complex executional decisions, escalating strategic trade offs as appropriate.
  • Identifies opportunities to evolve shopper creativity, design systems, and retail experience models.
  • Solves complex execution challenges by adapting global or regional concepts to local channel realities.
  • Contributes to continuous improvement of Shop X ways of working, tools, and processes.
  • Influences stakeholders across Product & Retail XP, Brand, IMX, Commercial, Frontline Marketing, and Bottler organizations.
  • Communicates creative ideas effectively to both creative and commercial audiences.
  • Builds strong, collaborative relationships with agencies, suppliers, and external partners.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; background in Marketing, Design, Advertising, or related field preferred.
  • 7–10 years of experience in Shopper Marketing, Retail Experience, Trade Marketing, or Creative Commerce, ideally within FMCG / CPG.
  • Proven experience developing creative shopper solutions that drive commercial impact.
  • Experience working with bottlers, distributors, or complex sales organizations.
  • Strong understanding of shopper behavior, channel dynamics, and retail execution.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects and agency partners.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese required.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Market Ownership: Lead Creative Shopper and Shop X execution in one of Coca Cola’s most important markets.
  • Iconic Brands: Shape how world class brands come to life at the point of sale.
  • Leadership Development: Build readiness for expanded scope or Director level roles.
  • Purpose Driven Work: Help refresh the world and make a difference through meaningful retail experiences.

Skills

Social Media; Sustainability; Brand Strategy; User Experience (UX) Design; Experimentation; Design Thinking; Design; Influencer Marketing; Audience Engagement; Data Insights; Market Segmentation; Storytelling; Ideas Generator; Data Strategies; Creative Strategies; Revenue Growth Management; AI Concepts; Portfolio Strategies; Negotiation; Agile; System Economics; Omnichannel Interactions

  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration – not just running them)
  • Docker containers (running evaluations locally in containers)

  • English proficiency – B2

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Senior Global Talent Sourcer

About Nu

Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:

About the team

The sourcing team is the engine behind Nu’s leadership growth. We are responsible for identifying and engaging the architects of our future. Our focus is on Tech functions, Executive (C-level, VP, Director) OR Enterprise/Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Compliance, and Business Development), driving efficiency through:

  • Executive Market Intelligence: Mapping the global landscape of leadership talent and understanding the movement of high-level executives across the FinTech and Enterprise sectors.
  • High-Touch Talent Analytics: Analyzing the quality and conversion of executive pipelines, ensuring we engage the right leaders for Nu’s long‑term global strategy.
  • Strategic Market Mapping: Identifying specialized "hunting grounds" for corporate excellence and creating exclusive, diverse talent pools of high‑impact passive candidates.
In this position, you will:
  • Target Executive Talent: Identify, map, and engage senior leaders and specialized corporate professionals capable of navigating complex, regulated global environments.
  • Advise Senior Stakeholders: Act as a strategic partner to hiring managers, providing data‑driven insights to influence hiring decisions and organizational design.
  • Master Personalized Outreach: Craft bespoke, highly professional engagement strategies for passive executive talent, ensuring a premium candidate experience from the first touchpoint.
  • Execute Global Mappings: Build robust market maps and cluster data on competitors and peer companies to identify top‑tier talent in Finance, Legal, Operations, and other Enterprise functions.
  • Manage Complexity: Balance the urgency of corporate needs with the discretion and long‑term relationship‑building required for executive‑level recruitment.
  • Drive Diversity at the Top: Proactively build diverse leadership pipelines, ensuring Nu’s executive layer reflects the diversity of our global customer base.
Requirements:
  • Proven Experience: Solid background in Tech sourcing , Executive Search or Corporate/Enterprise Sourcing (Finance, Legal, G&A, or Business functions) on a global scale.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to communicate and build rapport with high-level stakeholders and C‑suite candidates.
  • Analytical Rigor: Proficiency in using market data, compensation trends, and talent mapping tools to build autonomous strategies for leadership pipelines.
  • Discretion & Influence: Ability to handle confidential information and influence senior decision‑makers in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment.
  • Fluent English: Essential for global collaboration and executive engagement across regions.
Why Nubank?
  • Purpose‑driven work that impacts millions of people.

Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Oferecemos o Clude Saúde – Programa deserviços como Telemedicina e Telepsicologia oferecendo suporte e recursos para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental. Este benefício é sem custos ao funcionário e extensivo aos dependentes
